with matches as (
    select * from intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches
), joined as (
    select sm.marketo_lead_id, sm.stripe_customer_id, sm.zendesk_user_id,
           m.email as m_email, s.email as s_email, z.email as z_email,
           m.email_domain as m_domain, s.email_domain as s_domain, z.email_domain as z_domain,
           coalesce(m.organization_name_no_suffix, s.customer_organization_name_no_suffix, z.organization_name_no_suffix) as primary_organization,
           m.created_at as m_created, m.updated_at as m_updated, m.is_unsubscribed, m.is_email_invalid,
           m.organization_name_no_suffix as m_org, m.phone, m.mobile_phone, country_code, state_code, city,
           s.created_at as s_created, s.updated_at as s_updated, s.is_deleted as s_deleted, s.is_delinquent,
           customer_address_line_1, customer_country_code,
           z.created_at as z_created, z.updated_at as z_updated, z.is_deleted as z_deleted, z.is_suspended, z.is_active,
           organization_id, z.organization_name_no_suffix as z_org
    from matches sm
    left join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo m on sm.marketo_lead_id = m.lead_id
    left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on sm.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id
    left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk z on sm.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id
), scored as (
    select *,
        case when m_email is null then null when is_unsubscribed or is_email_invalid then 0
             when date_diff('day', m_created, m_updated) < 30 then 3
             when date_diff('day', m_created, m_updated) < 90 then 2 else 1 end as m_score,
        case when s_email is null then null when s_deleted then 0 when is_delinquent then 1
             when date_diff('day', s_created, s_updated) < 30 then 4
             when date_diff('day', s_created, s_updated) < 90 then 3 else 2 end as s_score,
        case when z_email is null then null when is_suspended or z_deleted then 0 when is_active = false then 1
             when date_diff('day', z_created, z_updated) < 30 then 4
             when date_diff('day', z_created, z_updated) < 90 then 3 else 2 end as z_score,
        case when m_org is not null and length(m_org)>3 then 1 else 0 end as org_score,
        case when phone is not null or mobile_phone is not null then 1 else 0 end as phone_score,
        case when country_code is not null and state_code is not null and city is not null then 3
             when country_code is not null and (state_code is not null or city is not null) then 2
             when country_code is not null then 1 else 0 end as address_score,
        case when s_email is not null and s_deleted = false and is_delinquent = false then 3
             when s_email is not null and is_delinquent = true and s_deleted = false then 1 else 0 end as reliability,
        case when customer_address_line_1 is not null and customer_country_code is not null then 2
             when customer_country_code is not null then 1 else 0 end as billing_score,
        case when organization_id is not null and z_org is not null then 2
             when organization_id is not null then 1 else 0 end as org_relationship
    from joined
), derived as (
    select *, coalesce(m_email,s_email,z_email) as primary_email,
        coalesce(m_domain,s_domain,z_domain) as email_domain,
        case when m_created is null or s_created is null or z_created is null then null else least(m_created,s_created,z_created) end as first_touch,
        case when m_updated is null or s_updated is null or z_updated is null then null else greatest(m_updated,s_updated,z_updated) end as last_activity,
        coalesce(m_score,0) as me, coalesce(s_score,0) as se, coalesce(z_score,0) as ze,
        (coalesce(m_score,0)*0.3 + coalesce(s_score,0)*0.5 + coalesce(z_score,0)*0.2)::decimal(14,1) as composite
    from scored
), segments as (
    select *, date_diff('day', first_touch, current_date)::bigint as age_days,
        case when m_email is not null then 1 else 0 end as im,
        case when s_email is not null then 1 else 0 end as is_,
        case when z_email is not null then 1 else 0 end as iz,
        case when m_email is not null and s_email is not null and z_email is not null then 'Full Journey'
             when m_email is not null and s_email is not null then 'Marketing to Sales'
             when s_email is not null and z_email is not null then 'Sales to Support'
             when m_email is not null and z_email is not null then 'Marketing to Support'
             when m_email is not null then 'Marketing Only' when s_email is not null then 'Sales Only'
             when z_email is not null then 'Support Only' else 'Unknown' end as journey,
        case when composite >= 3.5 and reliability >= 2 then 'Champion'
             when composite >= 3.0 and m_email is not null and s_email is not null and z_email is not null then 'Loyal Customer'
             when composite >= 2.5 and reliability >= 2 then 'Potential Loyalist'
             when composite >= 2.0 and date_diff('day', first_touch, current_date) < 90 then 'New Customer'
             when composite >= 1.5 then 'At Risk' when composite > 0 then 'Hibernating' else 'Lost' end as segment
    from derived
), labels as (
    select *, case when age_days < 90 then 'New Customer' when age_days < 365 then 'Growing Relationship'
                   when age_days < 1095 then 'Established Customer' else 'Long-term Customer' end as maturity,
        case when reliability=0 or composite<1 then 'High Risk'
             when composite<2 and age_days>365 then 'Medium Risk'
             when last_activity < current_timestamp - interval '90 days' then 'Medium Risk' else 'Low Risk' end as churn_risk
    from segments
)
select marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, primary_email, email_domain, primary_organization,
       first_touch as customer_first_touchpoint, last_activity as customer_last_activity,
       me as marketo_engagement, se as stripe_engagement, ze as zendesk_engagement,
       composite as composite_engagement_score, im as in_marketo, is_ as in_stripe, iz as in_zendesk,
       (coalesce(org_score,0)+coalesce(billing_score,0)+coalesce(org_relationship,0))::integer as organization_data_quality,
       coalesce(phone_score,0)::integer as has_contact_phone,
       (coalesce(address_score,0)+coalesce(billing_score,0))::integer as address_data_quality,
       case when m_created is not null and s_created is not null then date_diff('day',m_created,s_created) end::bigint as marketing_to_sales_days,
       case when s_created is not null and z_created is not null then date_diff('day',s_created,z_created) end::bigint as sales_to_support_days,
       age_days::bigint as account_age_days, maturity as customer_maturity, journey as customer_journey_pattern,
       reliability::integer as payment_reliability, segment as customer_segment,
       churn_risk as churn_risk_level,
       case segment when 'Champion' then 'Upsell/Cross-sell' when 'Loyal Customer' then 'Upsell/Cross-sell'
            when 'Potential Loyalist' then 'Engagement Campaign' when 'New Customer' then 'Onboarding Focus'
            when 'At Risk' then 'Win-back Campaign' when 'Hibernating' then 'Reactivation Campaign'
            else 'Recovery Campaign' end as recommended_action
from labels
where primary_email is not null

SELECT *, CAST(DATE_DIFF('DAY', first_touch, CURRENT_DATE) AS BIGINT) AS age_days, CASE WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS im, CASE WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_, CASE WHEN NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS iz, CASE WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Full Journey' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing to Sales' WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Sales to Support' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing to Support' WHEN NOT m_email IS NULL THEN 'Marketing Only' WHEN NOT s_email IS NULL THEN 'Sales Only' WHEN NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Support Only' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS journey, CASE WHEN composite >= 3.5 AND reliability >= 2 THEN 'Champion' WHEN composite >= 3.0 AND NOT m_email IS NULL AND NOT s_email IS NULL AND NOT z_email IS NULL THEN 'Loyal Customer' WHEN composite >= 2.5 AND reliability >= 2 THEN 'Potential Loyalist' WHEN composite >= 2.0 AND DATE_DIFF('DAY', first_touch, CURRENT_DATE) < 90 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN composite >= 1.5 THEN 'At Risk' WHEN composite > 0 THEN 'Hibernating' ELSE 'Lost' END AS segment FROM derived

SELECT *, CASE WHEN age_days < 90 THEN 'New Customer' WHEN age_days < 365 THEN 'Growing Relationship' WHEN age_days < 1095 THEN 'Established Customer' ELSE 'Long-term Customer' END AS maturity, CASE WHEN reliability = 0 OR composite < 1 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN composite < 2 AND age_days > 365 THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN last_activity < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '90' DAYS THEN 'Medium Risk' ELSE 'Low Risk' END AS churn_risk FROM segments

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      description: Customer behavior profile per resolved customer with cross-platform engagement, lifecycle metrics, and segmentation
      grain: One row per source match key (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id) with non-null primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: 'Build per-customer behavior and segmentation by: - Source inputs: - Marketo (intermediate.int_customer360__marketo) per lead_id - Stripe (intermediate.int_customer360__stripe) per customer_id - Zendesk (intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk) per user_id - Identity map (intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches) providing the cross-platform ID linkage - Per-platform metrics: - Marketo: - marketo_first_touch = created_at; marketo_last_activity = updated_at - marketo_engagement_score: - 0 if is_unsubscribed = true or is_email_invalid = true - else 3 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 2 if < 90 - else 1 - has_organization_data = 1 if organization_name_no_suffix not null and length > 3 else 0 - has_phone_contact = 1 if phone or mobile_phone present else 0 - address_completeness_score: - 3 if country_code, state_code, and city all present - 2 if country_code present and at least one of state_code or city present - 1 if only country_code present - 0 otherwise - Stripe: - stripe_first_transaction = created_at; stripe_last_activity = updated_at - stripe_engagement_score: - 0 if is_deleted = true - 1 if is_delinquent = true (and not deleted) - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - payment_reliability_score: - 3 if is_delinquent = false and is_deleted = false - 1 if is_delinquent = true and is_deleted = false - 0 otherwise - billing_completeness_score: - 2 if customer_address_line_1 and customer_country_code present - 1 if only customer_country_code present - 0 otherwise - Zendesk: - zendesk_first_contact = created_at; zendesk_last_activity = updated_at - zendesk_engagement_score: - 0 if is_suspended = true or is_deleted = true - 1 if is_active = false - else 4 if days between created_at and updated_at < 30 - else 3 if < 90 - else 2 - org_relationship_strength: - 2 if organization_id and organization_name_no_suffix present - 1 if only organization_id present - 0 otherwise - Join and aggregate: - Left join per-platform metrics to source_matches on respective IDs - primary_email = coalesce(Marketo.email, Stripe.email, Zendesk.email); rows with NULL primary_email are excluded - email_domain and primary_organization use the same COALESCE order (Marketo, then Stripe, then Zendesk) - customer_first_touchpoint = the earliest of the three per-platform first-touch timestamps - customer_last_activity = the latest of the three per-platform last-activity timestamps - If any of the three timestamps is NULL, the earliest/latest result is NULL - marketo_engagement/stripe_engagement/zendesk_engagement = respective per-platform scores with NULL → 0 - composite_engagement_score = weighted average (weights: Marketo 0.3, Stripe 0.5, Zendesk 0.2), rounded to two decimals and stored with one decimal precision - in_marketo/in_stripe/in_zendesk = 1 if respective joined record exists, else 0 - organization_data_quality = coalesce(has_organization_data,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(org_relationship_strength,0) - has_contact_phone = coalesce(has_phone_contact, 0) - address_data_quality = coalesce(address_completeness_score,0) + coalesce(billing_completeness_score,0) - marketing_to_sales_days = days between Marketo first touch and Stripe first transaction only if both present; else NULL - sales_to_support_days = days between Stripe first transaction and Zendesk first contact only if both present; else NULL - account_age_days = days between the earliest available first-touch and current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL - customer_maturity (derived from the same earliest timestamp vs current_date): - ''New Customer'' if < 90 days - ''Growing Relationship'' if < 365 days - ''Established Customer'' if < 1095 days - ''Long-term Customer'' otherwise (including when the start date is NULL) - customer_journey_pattern based on platform presence, evaluated in this order: - ''Full Journey'' if all three present - ''Marketing to Sales'' if Marketo and Stripe - ''Sales to Support'' if Stripe and Zendesk - ''Marketing to Support'' if Marketo and Zendesk - ''Marketing Only'' if only Marketo - ''Sales Only'' if only Stripe - ''Support Only'' if only Zendesk - ''Unknown'' otherwise - payment_reliability = coalesce(Stripe.payment_reliability_score, 0) - Classification: - customer_segment (first match wins): - ''Champion'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''Loyal Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 3.0 and customer_journey_pattern = ''Full Journey'' - ''Potential Loyalist'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.5 and payment_reliability >= 2 - ''New Customer'' if composite_engagement_score >= 2.0 and account_age_days < 90 - ''At Risk'' if composite_engagement_score >= 1.5 - ''Hibernating'' if composite_engagement_score > 0 - ''Lost'' otherwise - churn_risk_level: - ''High Risk'' if payment_reliability = 0 or composite_engagement_score < 1 - ''Medium Risk'' if composite_engagement_score < 2 and account_age_days > 365 - ''Medium Risk'' if customer_last_activity is more than 90 days ago - ''Low Risk'' otherwise (including when comparisons evaluate to NULL) - recommended_action based on customer_segment: - ''Upsell/Cross-sell'' for ''Champion'' or ''Loyal Customer'' - ''Engagement Campaign'' for ''Potential Loyalist'' - ''Onboarding Focus'' for ''New Customer'' - ''Win-back Campaign'' for ''At Risk'' - ''Reactivation Campaign'' for ''Hibernating'' - ''Recovery Campaign'' otherwise - Output filter and ordering: - Keep only rows where primary_email is not NULL - Order rows by composite_engagement_score descending, then account_age_days descending'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Marketo mapping exists
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Stripe mapping exists
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier from source_matches; nullable when no Zendesk mapping exists
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary email chosen by Marketo then Stripe then Zendesk; not null due to final filter; casing and spacing preserved
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: email_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Email domain chosen by the same precedence as primary_email; NULL if all source domains are NULL; formatting preserved
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization chosen by precedence Marketo, then Stripe, then Zendesk; NULL if all are NULL
      - name: customer_first_touchpoint
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest timestamp across the three platform first-touch timestamps; NULL if any input is NULL
      - name: customer_last_activity
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest timestamp across the three platform last-activity timestamps; NULL if any input is NULL
      - name: marketo_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Marketo engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3); NULL Marketo row yields 0
      - name: stripe_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Stripe engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3/4); NULL Stripe row yields 0
      - name: zendesk_engagement
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Zendesk engagement score per rules in business_logic (0/1/2/3/4); NULL Zendesk row yields 0
      - name: composite_engagement_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Weighted average of platform scores (weights 0.3, 0.5, 0.2), rounded to two decimals then stored with one decimal; missing scores treated as 0; range 0.0–3.7
      - name: in_marketo
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Marketo (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: in_stripe
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Stripe (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: in_zendesk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Zendesk (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: organization_data_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Aggregate org data score = has_organization_data(0/1) + billing_completeness_score(0/1/2) + org_relationship_strength(0/1/2); NULL components treated as 0; range 0–5
      - name: has_contact_phone
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if Marketo has phone or mobile_phone, else 0; NULL treated as 0; values strictly 0 or 1
      - name: address_data_quality
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Address/billing completeness = Marketo.address_completeness_score(0–3) + Stripe.billing_completeness_score(0–2); NULL components treated as 0; range 0–5
      - name: marketing_to_sales_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from Marketo first touch to Stripe first transaction; NULL unless both timestamps are non-null; may be negative or positive
      - name: sales_to_support_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from Stripe first transaction to Zendesk first contact; NULL unless both timestamps are non-null; may be negative or positive
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days from the earliest first-touch timestamp to current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL; computed at execution time
      - name: customer_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Lifecycle label based on days since earliest touch: New Customer (<90), Growing Relationship (<365), Established Customer (<1095), else Long-term Customer; NULL start yields Long-term Customer'
      - name: customer_journey_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Journey coverage across platforms with precedence: Full Journey; Marketing to Sales; Sales to Support; Marketing to Support; Marketing Only; Sales Only; Support Only; else Unknown'
      - name: payment_reliability
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Stripe-derived reliability score: 3 (not delinquent and not deleted), 1 (delinquent and not deleted), 0 otherwise; NULL Stripe row yields 0'
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Segment assigned by ordered rules: Champion; Loyal Customer; Potential Loyalist; New Customer; At Risk; Hibernating; else Lost'
      - name: churn_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk level by ordered rules: High if payment_reliability=0 or composite<1; Medium if composite<2 and age>365; Medium if last activity >90 days ago; else Low'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Next best action mapped from customer_segment: Upsell/Cross-sell; Engagement Campaign; Onboarding Focus; Win-back Campaign; Reactivation Campaign; else Recovery Campaign'

columns.description: Weighted average of platform scores (weights 0.3, 0.5, 0.2), rounded to two decimals then stored with one decimal; missing scores treated as 0; range 0.0–3.7

columns.name: in_marketo
columns.description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Marketo (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1

columns.name: in_stripe
columns.description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Stripe (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1

columns.name: in_zendesk
columns.description: Platform presence flag derived from join on Zendesk (1 if joined row exists, else 0); values strictly 0 or 1

columns.name: organization_data_quality
columns.description: Aggregate org data score = has_organization_data(0/1) + billing_completeness_score(0/1/2) + org_relationship_strength(0/1/2); NULL components treated as 0; range 0–5

columns.name: has_contact_phone
columns.description: 1 if Marketo has phone or mobile_phone, else 0; NULL treated as 0; values strictly 0 or 1

columns.name: address_data_quality
columns.description: Address/billing completeness = Marketo.address_completeness_score(0–3) + Stripe.billing_completeness_score(0–2); NULL components treated as 0; range 0–5

columns.name: marketing_to_sales_days
columns.description: Days from Marketo first touch to Stripe first transaction; NULL unless both timestamps are non-null; may be negative or positive

columns.name: sales_to_support_days
columns.description: Days from Stripe first transaction to Zendesk first contact; NULL unless both timestamps are non-null; may be negative or positive

columns.name: account_age_days
columns.description: Days from the earliest first-touch timestamp to current_date; NULL if the earliest is NULL; computed at execution time

columns.name: customer_maturity
columns.description: Lifecycle label based on days since earliest touch: New Customer (<90), Growing Relationship (<365), Established Customer (<1095), else Long-term Customer; NULL start yields Long-term Customer

columns.name: customer_journey_pattern
columns.description: Journey coverage across platforms with precedence: Full Journey; Marketing to Sales; Sales to Support; Marketing to Support; Marketing Only; Sales Only; Support Only; else Unknown

columns.name: payment_reliability
columns.description: Stripe-derived reliability score: 3 (not delinquent and not deleted), 1 (delinquent and not deleted), 0 otherwise; NULL Stripe row yields 0

columns.name: customer_segment
columns.description: Segment assigned by ordered rules: Champion; Loyal Customer; Potential Loyalist; New Customer; At Risk; Hibernating; else Lost

columns.name: churn_risk_level
columns.description: Risk level by ordered rules: High if payment_reliability=0 or composite<1; Medium if composite<2 and age>365; Medium if last activity >90 days ago; else Low

columns.name: recommended_action
columns.description: Next best action mapped from customer_segment: Upsell/Cross-sell; Engagement Campaign; Onboarding Focus; Win-back Campaign; Reactivation Campaign; else Recovery Campaign

agent_sql.raw_text:
with base as (
    select *, date_diff('day', customer_last_activity, current_date)::bigint as days_since_last_activity,
           date_trunc('month', customer_first_touchpoint)::date as acquisition_cohort_month,
           case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '30 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_30_days,
           case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '60 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_60_days,
           case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '90 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_90_days,
           case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '180 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_180_days,
           case when customer_last_activity >= current_timestamp - interval '365 days' then 1 else 0 end as active_365_days,
           coalesce(in_marketo,0)+coalesce(in_stripe,0)+coalesce(in_zendesk,0) as platform_sum
    from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
), stages as (
    select *, case when account_age_days <= 30 then 'Acquisition'
        when account_age_days <= 90 and active_30_days=1 then 'Activation'
        when account_age_days <= 365 and active_60_days=1 then 'Growth'
        when account_age_days > 365 and active_90_days=1 then 'Maturity'
        when days_since_last_activity > 180 then 'Dormant' else 'Retention' end as lifecycle_stage,
        case when platform_sum>=3 then 3 when platform_sum=2 then 2 else 1 end as platform_consistency_score,
        case customer_segment when 'Champion' then 5000.00 when 'Loyal Customer' then 3500.00
          when 'Potential Loyalist' then 2000.00 when 'New Customer' then 800.00 when 'At Risk' then 1200.00
          when 'Hibernating' then 500.00 else 200.00 end::decimal(6,2) as estimated_customer_value,
        case when days_since_last_activity<=7 then 5 when days_since_last_activity<=30 then 4
          when days_since_last_activity<=60 then 3 when days_since_last_activity<=180 then 2 else 1 end as recency_score,
        case when platform_sum>=2 and active_90_days=1 then 3 when active_180_days=1 then 2 else 1 end as frequency_score
    from base
), health as (
    select *, round(recency_score*0.3 + platform_consistency_score*0.3 +
       (case customer_segment when 'Champion' then 5.0 when 'Loyal Customer' then 4.5 when 'Potential Loyalist' then 3.5
        when 'New Customer' then 3.0 when 'At Risk' then 2.0 when 'Hibernating' then 1.5 else 1.0 end)*0.4,2)::decimal(15,2) as customer_health_score,
       case when customer_segment in ('Champion','Loyal Customer') then 2+floor(random()*8)
            when customer_segment='Potential Loyalist' then 1+floor(random()*4) else floor(random()*2) end::double as estimated_transaction_count
    from stages
), measures as (
    select *, round(estimated_customer_value*(1+0.2*frequency_score)*(1+0.1*platform_consistency_score)*
       (case lifecycle_stage when 'Growth' then 1.5 when 'Maturity' then 2.0 when 'Retention' then 1.8 when 'Activation' then 1.2 else 1.0 end),2)::decimal(18,2) as estimated_customer_ltv,
       case when customer_health_score>=4.5 then 0.95 when customer_health_score>=4 then 0.85 when customer_health_score>=3.5 then 0.75 when customer_health_score>=3 then 0.65 when customer_health_score>=2.5 then 0.50 when customer_health_score>=2 then 0.35 else 0.20 end::decimal(3,2) as retention_probability,
       case when customer_health_score>=4.5 then 0.05 when customer_health_score>=4 then 0.15 when customer_health_score>=3.5 then 0.25 when customer_health_score>=3 then 0.35 when customer_health_score>=2.5 then 0.50 when customer_health_score>=2 then 0.65 else 0.80 end::decimal(3,2) as churn_probability
    from health
), outputs as (
    select *, round(estimated_customer_value*churn_probability,2)::decimal(9,2) as revenue_at_risk,
       case when lifecycle_stage in ('Acquisition','Activation') and customer_health_score>=3.5 then 'High Growth Potential'
            when lifecycle_stage='Growth' and platform_consistency_score>=2 then 'Expansion Ready'
            when lifecycle_stage='Maturity' and customer_health_score>=4 then 'Upsell Candidate'
            when lifecycle_stage='Retention' and customer_health_score>=3 then 'Stable Account'
            when lifecycle_stage='Dormant' then 'Reactivation Needed' else 'Monitor' end as growth_potential,
       case when churn_probability>=0.65 then 5 when lifecycle_stage='Acquisition' and customer_health_score>=3.5 then 4
            when lifecycle_stage='Growth' and platform_consistency_score>=2 then 4
            when customer_health_score>=4 and estimated_customer_value>=3000 then 3
            when churn_probability>=0.35 then 3 else 2 end as action_priority
    from measures
), completed as (
    select *, case when month(acquisition_cohort_month) in (11,12,1) then 'Holiday Season'
       when month(acquisition_cohort_month) in (6,7,8) then 'Summer Season'
       when month(acquisition_cohort_month) in (3,4,5) then 'Spring Season' else 'Fall Season' end as acquisition_season,
       case when estimated_customer_ltv>=8000 then 'Platinum' when estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 'Gold'
            when estimated_customer_ltv>=2500 then 'Silver' when estimated_customer_ltv>=1000 then 'Bronze' else 'Basic' end as customer_tier,
       case when estimated_customer_ltv>=10000 or (customer_segment in ('Champion','Loyal Customer') and platform_consistency_score=3) then true else false end as is_strategic_account,
       case when estimated_customer_ltv>=8000 then 0.90 when estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 0.85
            when estimated_customer_ltv>=2500 and lifecycle_stage<>'Dormant' then 0.75
            when estimated_customer_ltv>=1000 and lifecycle_stage in ('Growth','Maturity') then 0.60 else 0.45 end::decimal(3,2) as expected_retention_rate
    from outputs
)
select marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, primary_email, primary_organization,
 customer_first_touchpoint, customer_last_activity, account_age_days, customer_segment, customer_journey_pattern,
 days_since_last_activity, active_30_days, active_60_days, active_90_days, active_180_days, active_365_days,
 lifecycle_stage, acquisition_cohort_month, platform_consistency_score, estimated_customer_value,
 frequency_score, recency_score, estimated_transaction_count, customer_health_score, estimated_customer_ltv,
 retention_probability, churn_probability, revenue_at_risk,
 case when acquisition_cohort_month is not null then year(acquisition_cohort_month)::bigint end as acquisition_year,
 case when acquisition_cohort_month is not null then month(acquisition_cohort_month)::bigint end as acquisition_month,
 case when acquisition_cohort_month is not null then date_diff('month',acquisition_cohort_month::date,current_date)::bigint end as months_since_acquisition,
 acquisition_season, customer_tier, is_strategic_account,
 case action_priority when 5 then 'Immediate' when 4 then 'This Week' when 3 then 'This Month' else 'Routine' end as intervention_urgency,
 expected_retention_rate,
 case when retention_probability>expected_retention_rate then 'Above Expectation'
      when retention_probability>=expected_retention_rate*0.8 then 'Meeting Expectation' else 'Below Expectation' end as performance_vs_expectation,
 growth_potential, action_priority
from completed

SELECT *, CASE WHEN account_age_days <= 30 THEN 'Acquisition' WHEN account_age_days <= 90 AND active_30_days = 1 THEN 'Activation' WHEN account_age_days <= 365 AND active_60_days = 1 THEN 'Growth' WHEN account_age_days > 365 AND active_90_days = 1 THEN 'Maturity' WHEN days_since_last_activity > 180 THEN 'Dormant' ELSE 'Retention' END AS lifecycle_stage, CASE WHEN platform_sum >= 3 THEN 3 WHEN platform_sum = 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS platform_consistency_score, CAST(CASE customer_segment WHEN 'Champion' THEN 5000.00 WHEN 'Loyal Customer' THEN 3500.00 WHEN 'Potential Loyalist' THEN 2000.00 WHEN 'New Customer' THEN 800.00 WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 1200.00 WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 500.00 ELSE 200.00 END AS DECIMAL(6, 2)) AS estimated_customer_value, CASE WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 7 THEN 5 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 30 THEN 4 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 60 THEN 3 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 180 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS recency_score, CASE WHEN platform_sum >= 2 AND active_90_days = 1 THEN 3 WHEN active_180_days = 1 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS frequency_score FROM base

SELECT *, CAST(ROUND(recency_score * 0.3 + platform_consistency_score * 0.3 + (CASE customer_segment WHEN 'Champion' THEN 5.0 WHEN 'Loyal Customer' THEN 4.5 WHEN 'Potential Loyalist' THEN 3.5 WHEN 'New Customer' THEN 3.0 WHEN 'At Risk' THEN 2.0 WHEN 'Hibernating' THEN 1.5 ELSE 1.0 END) * 0.4, 2) AS DECIMAL(15, 2)) AS customer_health_score, CAST(CASE WHEN customer_segment IN ('Champion', 'Loyal Customer') THEN 2 + FLOOR(RANDOM() * 8) WHEN customer_segment = 'Potential Loyalist' THEN 1 + FLOOR(RANDOM() * 4) ELSE FLOOR(RANDOM() * 2) END AS DOUBLE) AS estimated_transaction_count FROM stages

SELECT *, CAST(ROUND(estimated_customer_value * (1 + 0.2 * frequency_score) * (1 + 0.1 * platform_consistency_score) * (CASE lifecycle_stage WHEN 'Growth' THEN 1.5 WHEN 'Maturity' THEN 2.0 WHEN 'Retention' THEN 1.8 WHEN 'Activation' THEN 1.2 ELSE 1.0 END), 2) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS estimated_customer_ltv, CAST(CASE WHEN customer_health_score >= 4.5 THEN 0.95 WHEN customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 0.85 WHEN customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 0.75 WHEN customer_health_score >= 3 THEN 0.65 WHEN customer_health_score >= 2.5 THEN 0.50 WHEN customer_health_score >= 2 THEN 0.35 ELSE 0.20 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2)) AS retention_probability, CAST(CASE WHEN customer_health_score >= 4.5 THEN 0.05 WHEN customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 0.15 WHEN customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 0.25 WHEN customer_health_score >= 3 THEN 0.35 WHEN customer_health_score >= 2.5 THEN 0.50 WHEN customer_health_score >= 2 THEN 0.65 ELSE 0.80 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2)) AS churn_probability FROM health

SELECT *, CAST(ROUND(estimated_customer_value * churn_probability, 2) AS DECIMAL(9, 2)) AS revenue_at_risk, CASE WHEN lifecycle_stage IN ('Acquisition', 'Activation') AND customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 'High Growth Potential' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Growth' AND platform_consistency_score >= 2 THEN 'Expansion Ready' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Maturity' AND customer_health_score >= 4 THEN 'Upsell Candidate' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Retention' AND customer_health_score >= 3 THEN 'Stable Account' WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant' THEN 'Reactivation Needed' ELSE 'Monitor' END AS growth_potential, CASE WHEN churn_probability >= 0.65 THEN 5 WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Acquisition' AND customer_health_score >= 3.5 THEN 4 WHEN lifecycle_stage = 'Growth' AND platform_consistency_score >= 2 THEN 4 WHEN customer_health_score >= 4 AND estimated_customer_value >= 3000 THEN 3 WHEN churn_probability >= 0.35 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS action_priority FROM measures

SELECT *, CASE WHEN MONTH(acquisition_cohort_month) IN (11, 12, 1) THEN 'Holiday Season' WHEN MONTH(acquisition_cohort_month) IN (6, 7, 8) THEN 'Summer Season' WHEN MONTH(acquisition_cohort_month) IN (3, 4, 5) THEN 'Spring Season' ELSE 'Fall Season' END AS acquisition_season, CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 8000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2500 THEN 'Silver' WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 1000 THEN 'Bronze' ELSE 'Basic' END AS customer_tier, CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 10000 OR (customer_segment IN ('Champion', 'Loyal Customer') AND platform_consistency_score = 3) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_strategic_account, CAST(CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 8000 THEN 0.90 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 0.85 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2500 AND lifecycle_stage <> 'Dormant' THEN 0.75 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 1000 AND lifecycle_stage IN ('Growth', 'Maturity') THEN 0.60 ELSE 0.45 END AS DECIMAL(3, 2)) AS expected_retention_rate FROM outputs

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      description: Customer lifecycle metrics, health scoring, retention/churn risk, and cohort/tier enrichments derived from customer behavior analysis
      grain: One row per customer from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      business_logic: 'Starting from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (one row per resolved customer), compute lifecycle metrics and enrichments: - Activity windows and recency: - days_since_last_activity = number of days between customer_last_activity and today; NULL if customer_last_activity is missing. - active_X_days flags (X ∈ {30,60,90,180,365}) = 1 if customer_last_activity occurred within X days of today, else 0; missing customer_last_activity yields 0. - Lifecycle stage (first match wins): - ''Acquisition'' if account_age_days ≤ 30 - ''Activation'' if account_age_days ≤ 90 and last_activity within 30 days - ''Growth'' if account_age_days ≤ 365 and last_activity within 60 days - ''Maturity'' if account_age_days > 365 and last_activity within 90 days - ''Dormant'' if last_activity older than 180 days - Else ''Retention'' - Note: NULL account_age_days or last_activity causes earlier conditions to fail and typically falls through to ''Retention''. - Cohort and platform consistency: - acquisition_cohort_month = month of the first touchpoint (truncated to month); NULL if first_touchpoint is missing. - platform_consistency_score ∈ {1,2,3}: sum of presence flags (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk); 3 if sum ≥ 3, 2 if sum = 2, else 1. NULL in any flag leads to the else path → 1. - Value and engagement scores: - estimated_customer_value (DECIMAL(6,2)) by customer_segment: - ''Champion'' 5000.00; ''Loyal Customer'' 3500.00; ''Potential Loyalist'' 2000.00; ''New Customer'' 800.00; ''At Risk'' 1200.00; ''Hibernating'' 500.00; else 200.00. - frequency_score (1–5): 5 if platform_consistency_score = 3 and active_30_days = 1; 4 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_60_days = 1; 3 if platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 and active_90_days = 1; 2 if active_180_days = 1; else 1. - recency_score (1–5) by days_since_last_activity: 5 (≤7), 4 (≤30), 3 (≤60), 2 (≤180), else 1; NULL days_since_last_activity maps to 1. - estimated_transaction_count (DOUBLE): simulated per run: - If segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') → integer 2–9 - If ''Potential Loyalist'' → integer 1–4 - Else → integer 0–1 - Stored as DOUBLE; values vary each execution. - customer_health_score (DECIMAL(15,2)) = rounded to 2 decimals from: recency_component*0.3 + platform_consistency_score*0.3 + segment_component*0.4, where: - recency_component: 5/4/3/2/1 as in recency_score logic - segment_component: ''Champion'' 5.0; ''Loyal Customer'' 4.5; ''Potential Loyalist'' 3.5; ''New Customer'' 3.0; ''At Risk'' 2.0; ''Hibernating'' 1.5; else 1.0 - Advanced lifecycle metrics: - estimated_customer_ltv (DECIMAL(18,2)) = estimated_customer_value × (1 + 0.2 × frequency_score) × (1 + 0.1 × platform_consistency_score) × stage_factor; rounded to 2 decimals, where stage_factor: Growth 1.5; Maturity 2.0; Retention 1.8; Activation 1.2; else 1.0. - retention_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) by customer_health_score: ≥4.5→0.95; ≥4.0→0.85; ≥3.5→0.75; ≥3.0→0.65; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.35; else 0.20. - churn_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) inverse mapping: ≥4.5→0.05; ≥4.0→0.15; ≥3.5→0.25; ≥3.0→0.35; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.65; else 0.80. - revenue_at_risk (DECIMAL(9,2)) = estimated_customer_value × churn-probability mapping above; rounded to 2 decimals. - growth_potential (first match wins): - ''High Growth Potential'' if lifecycle_stage in (''Acquisition'',''Activation'') and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - ''Expansion Ready'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - ''Upsell Candidate'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Maturity'' and customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 - ''Stable Account'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Retention'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.0 - ''Reactivation Needed'' if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' - Else ''Monitor'' - action_priority (INT, first match wins): - 5 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.65 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Acquisition'' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = ''Growth'' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - 3 if customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 and estimated_customer_value ≥ 3000 - 3 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.35 - Else 2 - acquisition_year = year of acquisition_cohort_month; acquisition_month = month number; months_since_acquisition = whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL. - acquisition_season: ''Holiday Season'' if month in (11,12,1); ''Summer Season'' if in (6,7,8); ''Spring Season'' if in (3,4,5); else ''Fall Season'' (default for NULL or not matched). - Final enrichments: - customer_tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic. - is_strategic_account = TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 OR (customer_segment in (''Champion'',''Loyal Customer'') AND platform_consistency_score = 3); else FALSE. - intervention_urgency by action_priority: 5→''Immediate''; 4→''This Week''; 3→''This Month''; else ''Routine''. - expected_retention_rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90 if LTV ≥ 8000; 0.85 if LTV ≥ 5000; 0.75 if LTV ≥ 2500 and lifecycle_stage ≠ ''Dormant''; 0.60 if LTV ≥ 1000 and lifecycle_stage in (''Growth'',''Maturity''); else 0.45. - performance_vs_expectation: ''Above Expectation'' if retention_probability > expected_retention_rate; ''Meeting Expectation'' if retention_probability ≥ 80% of expected_retention_rate; else ''Below Expectation''. - Output ordering: sorted by is_strategic_account (true first), then action_priority descending, then estimated_customer_ltv descending, then customer_health_score descending.'

      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier; may be NULL
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier; may be NULL
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary resolved customer email
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved customer organization or account label
      - name: customer_first_touchpoint
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest known customer interaction; used to derive acquisition_cohort_month
      - name: customer_last_activity
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent activity timestamp; used for recency and active window flags
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account age in days; used in lifecycle_stage rules
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Behavioral segment driving value and scoring rules
      - name: customer_journey_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Descriptive journey pattern label
      - name: days_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Days between customer_last_activity and today; NULL if customer_last_activity is NULL
      - name: active_30_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 30 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: active_60_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 60 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: active_90_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 90 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: active_180_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 180 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: active_365_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 1 if last_activity within 365 days of today, else 0; NULL last_activity yields 0
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage from ordered rules using account_age_days and recency: Acquisition, Activation, Growth, Maturity, Dormant, else Retention'
      - name: acquisition_cohort_month
        data_type: DATE
        description: Month of first touchpoint; NULL if customer_first_touchpoint is NULL
      - name: platform_consistency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Cross-platform presence score: 3 if all three sources, 2 if two, else 1; NULL flags fall through to 1'
      - name: estimated_customer_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(6,2)
        description: Segment-based monetary value estimate with fixed mapping; never NULL
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Engagement frequency score (1–5) from platform consistency and recent activity per ordered rules
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Recency score (1–5) from days_since_last_activity thresholds; NULL recency maps to 1
      - name: estimated_transaction_count
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Simulated integer count: 2–9 for top segments, 1–4 for Potential Loyalist, else 0–1; varies each run'
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: 'Weighted composite: 0.3×recency_component + 0.3×platform_consistency + 0.4×segment_component; rounded to 2 decimals'
      - name: estimated_customer_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: LTV estimate from value × frequency × platform × stage_factor; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: retention_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Probability mapped from customer_health_score thresholds (≥4.5→0.95 down to else 0.20)
      - name: churn_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Inverse of retention mapping from customer_health_score (≥4.5→0.05 up to else 0.80)
      - name: revenue_at_risk
        data_type: DECIMAL(9,2)
        description: Estimated_customer_value multiplied by churn mapping; rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: growth_potential
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Categorical potential per ordered rules using lifecycle_stage, platform consistency, and health score
      - name: action_priority
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Next-action priority (2–5) from ordered rules using churn mapping, lifecycle, platform consistency, health, and value
      - name: acquisition_year
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Year extracted from acquisition_cohort_month; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: acquisition_month
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Month number (1–12) extracted from acquisition_cohort_month; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: months_since_acquisition
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL
      - name: acquisition_season
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Season by acquisition month: Holiday (11,12,1), Summer (6,7,8), Spring (3,4,5), else Fall (default for NULL/not matched)'
      - name: customer_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic'
      - name: is_strategic_account
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 or (segment in ('Champion','Loyal Customer') and platform_consistency_score = 3), else FALSE
      - name: intervention_urgency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Urgency label by action_priority: 5→Immediate; 4→This Week; 3→This Month; else Routine'
      - name: expected_retention_rate
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Expected rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90, 0.85, 0.75 (non-Dormant), 0.60 (Growth/Maturity), else 0.45'
      - name: performance_vs_expectation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Comparison of retention_probability vs expected_retention_rate: Above (>), Meeting (≥80%), or Below'

rounded to 2 decimals, where stage_factor: Growth 1.5; Maturity 2.0; Retention 1.8; Activation 1.2; else 1.0. - retention_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) by customer_health_score: ≥4.5→0.95; ≥4.0→0.85; ≥3.5→0.75; ≥3.0→0.65; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.35; else 0.20. - churn_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)) inverse mapping: ≥4.5→0.05; ≥4.0→0.15; ≥3.5→0.25; ≥3.0→0.35; ≥2.5→0.50; ≥2.0→0.65; else 0.80. - revenue_at_risk (DECIMAL(9,2)) = estimated_customer_value × churn-probability mapping above; rounded to 2 decimals. - growth_potential (first match wins): - 'High Growth Potential' if lifecycle_stage in ('Acquisition','Activation') and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - 'Expansion Ready' if lifecycle_stage = 'Growth' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - 'Upsell Candidate' if lifecycle_stage = 'Maturity' and customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 - 'Stable Account' if lifecycle_stage = 'Retention' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.0 - 'Reactivation Needed' if lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant' - Else 'Monitor' - action_priority (INT, first match wins): - 5 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.65 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = 'Acquisition' and customer_health_score ≥ 3.5 - 4 if lifecycle_stage = 'Growth' and platform_consistency_score ≥ 2 - 3 if customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 and estimated_customer_value ≥ 3000 - 3 if churn-probability mapping ≥ 0.35 - Else 2 - acquisition_year = year of acquisition_cohort_month; acquisition_month = month number; months_since_acquisition = whole months between acquisition_cohort_month and today; NULL if acquisition_cohort_month is NULL. - acquisition_season: 'Holiday Season' if month in (11,12,1); 'Summer Season' if in (6,7,8); 'Spring Season' if in (3,4,5); else 'Fall Season' (default for NULL or not matched). - Final enrichments: - customer_tier by estimated_customer_ltv: Platinum (≥8000), Gold (≥5000), Silver (≥2500), Bronze (≥1000), else Basic. - is_strategic_account = TRUE if estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 10000 OR (customer_segment in ('Champion','Loyal Customer') AND platform_consistency_score = 3); else FALSE. - intervention_urgency by action_priority: 5→'Immediate'; 4→'This Week'; 3→'This Month'; else 'Routine'. - expected_retention_rate by LTV and lifecycle: 0.90 if LTV ≥ 8000; 0.85 if LTV ≥ 5000; 0.75 if LTV ≥ 2500 and lifecycle_stage ≠ 'Dormant'; 0.60 if LTV ≥ 1000 and lifecycle_stage in ('Growth','Maturity'); else 0.45. - performance_vs_expectation: 'Above Expectation' if retention_probability > expected_retention_rate; 'Meeting Expectation' if retention_probability ≥ 80% of expected_retention_rate; else 'Below Expectation'. - Output ordering: sorted by is_strategic_account (true first), then action_priority descending, then estimated_customer_ltv descending, then customer_health_score descending.

agent_sql.raw_text:
with behavior as (
 select ba.*, lm.customer_health_score, lm.lifecycle_stage, lm.active_30_days, lm.active_90_days,
        lm.platform_consistency_score, lm.estimated_customer_ltv, lm.churn_probability
 from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis ba
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics lm using (primary_email)
), joined as (
 select b.*, s.is_delinquent, s.is_deleted as stripe_deleted, s.created_at as stripe_account_created,
        s.updated_at as stripe_last_update, z.is_active as zendesk_active, z.is_suspended as zendesk_suspended,
        z.is_deleted as zendesk_deleted, z.organization_id, z.created_at as zendesk_account_created,
        z.updated_at as zendesk_last_update
 from behavior b
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on b.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk z on b.zendesk_user_id=z.user_id
), risk as (
 select *, case when date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)>90 then 3
 when date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)>60 then 2 when date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)>30 then 1 else 0 end as activity_decline_risk,
 case when in_marketo+in_stripe+in_zendesk=1 then 2 when in_marketo+in_stripe+in_zendesk=2 then 1 else 0 end as platform_abandonment_risk,
 case when lifecycle_stage='Dormant' then 3 when lifecycle_stage='Retention' and customer_health_score<3 then 2
 when lifecycle_stage in ('Acquisition','Activation') and date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)>30 then 2 else 0 end as lifecycle_transition_risk,
 case when marketo_lead_id is null then 0 when date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)>60 then 2 when composite_engagement_score<2 then 1 else 0 end as email_engagement_risk,
 case when is_delinquent then 3 when stripe_deleted then 4 when estimated_customer_ltv>5000 and churn_probability>0.5 then 2 else 0 end as payment_behavior_risk,
 case when stripe_customer_id is not null and date_diff('day',stripe_account_created,stripe_last_update)<30 then 1 when stripe_deleted then 3 else 0 end as account_stability_risk,
 case when estimated_customer_ltv>=10000 and churn_probability>=0.5 then 4 when estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 and churn_probability>=0.5 then 3 when estimated_customer_ltv>=2000 and churn_probability>=0.7 then 2 when churn_probability>=0.8 then 1 else 0 end as revenue_at_risk_score,
 case when zendesk_suspended then 3 when zendesk_deleted then 2 when zendesk_active=false then 2 when zendesk_user_id is not null and zendesk_last_update<current_timestamp-interval '90 days' then 1 else 0 end as support_engagement_risk,
 case when organization_id is null and primary_organization is not null then 1 when zendesk_suspended and organization_id is not null then 2 else 0 end as org_relationship_risk,
 case when customer_segment in ('At Risk','Hibernating','Lost') then 2 when churn_risk_level='High Risk' then 3 when lifecycle_stage='Dormant' and zendesk_active=false then 2 else 0 end as satisfaction_risk_score
 from joined where primary_email is not null
), sums as (
 select *, activity_decline_risk+platform_abandonment_risk+lifecycle_transition_risk+email_engagement_risk+payment_behavior_risk+account_stability_risk+revenue_at_risk_score as S,
 round(activity_decline_risk*.2+platform_abandonment_risk*.15+lifecycle_transition_risk*.15+email_engagement_risk*.1+payment_behavior_risk*.25+account_stability_risk*.1+revenue_at_risk_score*.05,2) as total_risk_score
 from risk
), labels as (
 select *, case when S>=8 then 'Critical' when S>=5 then 'High' when S>=3 then 'Medium' when S>=1 then 'Low' else 'Minimal' end as risk_category,
 case when payment_behavior_risk>0 then 'Payment Issues' when activity_decline_risk>0 then 'Engagement Decline' when lifecycle_transition_risk>0 then 'Lifecycle Transition' when revenue_at_risk_score>0 then 'High Value at Risk' when support_engagement_risk>0 then 'Support Issues' when email_engagement_risk>0 then 'Communication Breakdown' else 'Standard Monitoring' end as primary_risk_factor,
 case when date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)<=7 and customer_health_score>=4 then 'Improving' when date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)<=30 and churn_probability<.3 then 'Stable' when date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date) between 31 and 60 then 'Declining' when date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)>60 then 'Deteriorating' else 'Unknown' end as risk_trend,
 round(estimated_customer_ltv*churn_probability,2) as potential_revenue_loss,
 case when payment_behavior_risk>=3 then 'Immediate (24h)' when activity_decline_risk+platform_abandonment_risk+lifecycle_transition_risk>=5 then 'Urgent (1 week)' when revenue_at_risk_score>=3 then 'High Priority (2 weeks)' when activity_decline_risk+email_engagement_risk>=3 then 'Medium Priority (1 month)' else 'Standard Priority' end as intervention_timeline,
 case when payment_behavior_risk>0 then 'Account Management Call' when activity_decline_risk>=2 and estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 'Executive Outreach' when support_engagement_risk>0 then 'Customer Success Check-in' when email_engagement_risk>0 then 'Personalized Email Campaign' when platform_abandonment_risk>0 then 'Product Adoption Workshop' when lifecycle_stage is not null then 'Lifecycle-specific Campaign' else 'Automated Monitoring' end as recommended_intervention,
 case when S>=8 then .30 when S>=5 then .60 when S>=3 then .80 when S>=1 then .90 else .95 end as intervention_success_probability
 from sums
), final as (
 select *, round((case risk_category when 'Critical' then 5 when 'High' then 4 when 'Medium' then 3 when 'Low' then 2 else 1 end*.6+
 case when estimated_customer_ltv>=10000 then 5 when estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 4 when estimated_customer_ltv>=2000 then 3 when estimated_customer_ltv>=1000 then 2 else 1 end*.4),2)::decimal(13,1) as customer_priority_score,
 round(estimated_customer_ltv*(1-churn_probability)*intervention_success_probability,2) as risk_adjusted_customer_value,
 (payment_behavior_risk>=3 or revenue_at_risk_score>=4) as critical_alert_flag,
 (activity_decline_risk>=2 and estimated_customer_ltv>=3000) as high_value_at_risk_flag,
 (platform_abandonment_risk>=2 and customer_health_score<3) as engagement_warning_flag,
 round(estimated_customer_ltv*intervention_success_probability*.7-case recommended_intervention when 'Account Management Call' then 500 when 'Executive Outreach' then 1000 when 'Customer Success Check-in' then 200 when 'Personalized Email Campaign' then 50 when 'Product Adoption Workshop' then 300 when 'Lifecycle-specific Campaign' then 100 else 25 end,2) as intervention_roi
 from labels
)
select marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, primary_email, primary_organization, composite_engagement_score, customer_segment, churn_risk_level,
 date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)::bigint as days_since_last_activity, customer_health_score,lifecycle_stage,active_30_days,active_90_days,platform_consistency_score,
 estimated_customer_ltv,churn_probability,activity_decline_risk,platform_abandonment_risk,lifecycle_transition_risk,email_engagement_risk,
 is_delinquent,stripe_deleted,stripe_account_created,stripe_last_update,payment_behavior_risk,account_stability_risk,revenue_at_risk_score,
 zendesk_active,zendesk_suspended,zendesk_deleted,organization_id,zendesk_account_created,zendesk_last_update,support_engagement_risk,org_relationship_risk,satisfaction_risk_score,
 total_risk_score,risk_category,primary_risk_factor,risk_trend,potential_revenue_loss,intervention_timeline,recommended_intervention,intervention_success_probability,
 customer_priority_score,risk_adjusted_customer_value,critical_alert_flag,high_value_at_risk_flag,engagement_warning_flag,intervention_roi,current_timestamp as risk_assessment_timestamp
from final

blocks.original_text:
- name: int_customer360__risk_assessment
      description: Multi-dimensional customer risk assessment derived from behavior, lifecycle, payment, and support signals with computed scores, classifications, flags, interventions, ROI, and timestamp
      grain: One row per intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis record with non-null primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: 'Build engagement_risk_scoring: - Input rows from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (ba) left joined to intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (lm) on primary_email. - Compute days_since_last_activity as the number of days between ba.customer_last_activity and today; set to NULL if ba.customer_last_activity is missing. - activity_decline_risk: >90 days → 3; >60 days → 2; >30 days → 1; otherwise → 0. - platform_abandonment_risk from presence across Marketo/Stripe/Zendesk (ba.in_marketo + ba.in_stripe + ba.in_zendesk): sum = 1 → 2; sum = 2 → 1; otherwise → 0. - lifecycle_transition_risk: Dormant → 3; Retention with customer_health_score < 3.0 → 2; Acquisition/Activation with days_since_last_activity > 30 → 2; otherwise → 0. - email_engagement_risk (only if marketo_lead_id is present): days_since_last_activity > 60 → 2; else if composite_engagement_score < 2.0 → 1; otherwise → 0; if marketo_lead_id is missing → 0. Build payment_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe (s) on ers.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id. - payment_behavior_risk precedence: is_delinquent = true → 3; else if is_deleted = true → 4; else if estimated_customer_ltv > 5000 and churn_probability > 0.5 → 2; otherwise → 0. - account_stability_risk: stripe customer exists and days between created_at and updated_at < 30 → 1; else if is_deleted = true → 3; otherwise → 0. - revenue_at_risk_score precedence: LTV ≥ 10000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 4; else if LTV ≥ 5000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 3; else if LTV ≥ 2000 and churn ≥ 0.7 → 2; else if churn ≥ 0.8 → 1; otherwise → 0. Build support_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk (z) on prs.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id. - support_engagement_risk precedence: suspended → 3; else if deleted → 2; else if active = false → 2; else if user present and last_update was > 90 days ago → 1; otherwise → 0. - org_relationship_risk: missing organization_id with non-missing primary_organization → 1; else if suspended with organization_id present → 2; otherwise → 0. - satisfaction_risk_score precedence: segment in (''At Risk'',''Hibernating'',''Lost'') → 2; else if churn_risk_level = ''High Risk'' → 3; else if lifecycle_stage = ''Dormant'' and zendesk_active = false → 2; otherwise → 0. Build comprehensive_risk_assessment: - total_risk_score = weighted sum of seven risk components (weights: 0.2 activity_decline, 0.15 platform_abandonment, 0.15 lifecycle_transition, 0.1 email_engagement, 0.25 payment_behavior, 0.1 account_stability, 0.05 revenue_at_risk), rounded to 2 decimals. - risk_category from the unweighted sum S of the seven components: S ≥ 8 → Critical; S ≥ 5 → High; S ≥ 3 → Medium; S ≥ 1 → Low; otherwise → Minimal. - primary_risk_factor precedence: Payment Issues; else Engagement Decline; else Lifecycle Transition; else High Value at Risk; else Support Issues; else Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring. - risk_trend precedence: days_since_last_activity ≤ 7 with customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → Improving; else if days_since_last_activity ≤ 30 with churn_probability < 0.3 → Stable; else if 30 < days_since_last_activity ≤ 60 → Declining; else if days_since_last_activity > 60 → Deteriorating; otherwise → Unknown. - potential_revenue_loss = estimated_customer_ltv × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - intervention_timeline precedence: payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 → Immediate (24h); else if activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk ≥ 5 → Urgent (1 week); else if revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 3 → High Priority (2 weeks); else if activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk ≥ 3 → Medium Priority (1 month); otherwise → Standard Priority. - recommended_intervention precedence: Account Management Call; else Executive Outreach (activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and LTV ≥ 5000); else Customer Success Check-in; else Personalized Email Campaign; else Product Adoption Workshop; else Lifecycle-specific Campaign; otherwise Automated Monitoring. - intervention_success_probability from S (same sum used for risk_category): S ≥ 8 → 0.30; S ≥ 5 → 0.60; S ≥ 3 → 0.80; S ≥ 1 → 0.90; otherwise → 0.95. Build final_risk_assessment: - customer_priority_score = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4), then rounded; risk_category scores: Critical=5, High=4, Medium=3, Low=2, Minimal=1; LTV brackets: ≥10000=5, ≥5000=4, ≥2000=3, ≥1000=2, else=1. Note: logic rounds to 2 decimals; stored with one-decimal precision per column type. - risk_adjusted_customer_value = estimated_customer_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - critical_alert_flag = payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 OR revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4. - high_value_at_risk_flag = activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000. - engagement_warning_flag = platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 AND customer_health_score < 3.0. - intervention_roi = (estimated_customer_ltv × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost by recommended_intervention: Account Management Call=500; Executive Outreach=1000; Customer Success Check-in=200; Personalized Email Campaign=50; Product Adoption Workshop=300; Lifecycle-specific Campaign=100; otherwise=25. - risk_assessment_timestamp = current execution timestamp with time zone. - Final filter: include only rows with non-null primary_email. - Ordering: sort by critical_alert_flag (descending), then customer_priority_score (descending), potential_revenue_loss (descending), and total_risk_score (descending).'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier from behavior_analysis; NULL allowed; used to gate email_engagement_risk
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier from behavior_analysis; join key to stripe_data; NULL allowed
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier from behavior_analysis; join key to zendesk_data; NULL allowed

        description: 'Success probability from the sum of seven risk components: ≥8 → 0.30; ≥5 → 0.60; ≥3 → 0.80; ≥1 → 0.90; else → 0.95'
      - name: customer_priority_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(13,1)
        description: Overall priority = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4); logic rounds to 2 decimals and value is stored with one-decimal precision
      - name: risk_adjusted_customer_value
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Value = LTV × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if inputs are NULL
      - name: critical_alert_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 or revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4; else false
      - name: high_value_at_risk_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000; else false
      - name: engagement_warning_flag
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 and customer_health_score < 3.0; else false
      - name: intervention_roi
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: ROI = (LTV × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − intervention cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost per intervention per defined schedule
      - name: risk_assessment_timestamp
        data_type: TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE
        description: Execution timestamp captured at run time with time zone

specification.name: int_customer360__risk_assessment
specification.description: Multi-dimensional customer risk assessment derived from behavior, lifecycle, payment, and support signals with computed scores, classifications, flags, interventions, ROI, and timestamp
specification.grain: One row per intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis record with non-null primary_email
specification.business_logic: Build engagement_risk_scoring: - Input rows from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (ba) left joined to intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (lm) on primary_email. - Compute days_since_last_activity as the number of days between ba.customer_last_activity and today; set to NULL if ba.customer_last_activity is missing. - activity_decline_risk: >90 days → 3; >60 days → 2; >30 days → 1; otherwise → 0. - platform_abandonment_risk from presence across Marketo/Stripe/Zendesk (ba.in_marketo + ba.in_stripe + ba.in_zendesk): sum = 1 → 2; sum = 2 → 1; otherwise → 0. - lifecycle_transition_risk: Dormant → 3; Retention with customer_health_score < 3.0 → 2; Acquisition/Activation with days_since_last_activity > 30 → 2; otherwise → 0. - email_engagement_risk (only if marketo_lead_id is present): days_since_last_activity > 60 → 2; else if composite_engagement_score < 2.0 → 1; otherwise → 0; if marketo_lead_id is missing → 0. Build payment_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe (s) on ers.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id. - payment_behavior_risk precedence: is_delinquent = true → 3; else if is_deleted = true → 4; else if estimated_customer_ltv > 5000 and churn_probability > 0.5 → 2; otherwise → 0. - account_stability_risk: stripe customer exists and days between created_at and updated_at < 30 → 1; else if is_deleted = true → 3; otherwise → 0. - revenue_at_risk_score precedence: LTV ≥ 10000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 4; else if LTV ≥ 5000 and churn ≥ 0.5 → 3; else if LTV ≥ 2000 and churn ≥ 0.7 → 2; else if churn ≥ 0.8 → 1; otherwise → 0. Build support_risk_scoring: - Left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk (z) on prs.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id. - support_engagement_risk precedence: suspended → 3; else if deleted → 2; else if active = false → 2; else if user present and last_update was > 90 days ago → 1; otherwise → 0. - org_relationship_risk: missing organization_id with non-missing primary_organization → 1; else if suspended with organization_id present → 2; otherwise → 0. - satisfaction_risk_score precedence: segment in ('At Risk','Hibernating','Lost') → 2; else if churn_risk_level = 'High Risk' → 3; else if lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant' and zendesk_active = false → 2; otherwise → 0. Build comprehensive_risk_assessment: - total_risk_score = weighted sum of seven risk components (weights: 0.2 activity_decline, 0.15 platform_abandonment, 0.15 lifecycle_transition, 0.1 email_engagement, 0.25 payment_behavior, 0.1 account_stability, 0.05 revenue_at_risk), rounded to 2 decimals. - risk_category from the unweighted sum S of the seven components: S ≥ 8 → Critical; S ≥ 5 → High; S ≥ 3 → Medium; S ≥ 1 → Low; otherwise → Minimal. - primary_risk_factor precedence: Payment Issues; else Engagement Decline; else Lifecycle Transition; else High Value at Risk; else Support Issues; else Communication Breakdown; else Standard Monitoring. - risk_trend precedence: days_since_last_activity ≤ 7 with customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → Improving; else if days_since_last_activity ≤ 30 with churn_probability < 0.3 → Stable; else if 30 < days_since_last_activity ≤ 60 → Declining; else if days_since_last_activity > 60 → Deteriorating; otherwise → Unknown. - potential_revenue_loss = estimated_customer_ltv × churn_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - intervention_timeline precedence: payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 → Immediate (24h); else if activity_decline_risk + platform_abandonment_risk + lifecycle_transition_risk ≥ 5 → Urgent (1 week); else if revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 3 → High Priority (2 weeks); else if activity_decline_risk + email_engagement_risk ≥ 3 → Medium Priority (1 month); otherwise → Standard Priority. - recommended_intervention precedence: Account Management Call; else Executive Outreach (activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 and LTV ≥ 5000); else Customer Success Check-in; else Personalized Email Campaign; else Product Adoption Workshop; else Lifecycle-specific Campaign; otherwise Automated Monitoring. - intervention_success_probability from S (same sum used for risk_category): S ≥ 8 → 0.30; S ≥ 5 → 0.60; S ≥ 3 → 0.80; S ≥ 1 → 0.90; otherwise → 0.95. Build final_risk_assessment: - customer_priority_score = (risk_category score × 0.6) + (LTV bracket score × 0.4), then rounded; risk_category scores: Critical=5, High=4, Medium=3, Low=2, Minimal=1; LTV brackets: ≥10000=5, ≥5000=4, ≥2000=3, ≥1000=2, else=1. Note: logic rounds to 2 decimals; stored with one-decimal precision per column type. - risk_adjusted_customer_value = estimated_customer_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) × intervention_success_probability, rounded to 2 decimals. - critical_alert_flag = payment_behavior_risk ≥ 3 OR revenue_at_risk_score ≥ 4. - high_value_at_risk_flag = activity_decline_risk ≥ 2 AND estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000. - engagement_warning_flag = platform_abandonment_risk ≥ 2 AND customer_health_score < 3.0. - intervention_roi = (estimated_customer_ltv × intervention_success_probability × 0.7) − cost, rounded to 2 decimals; cost by recommended_intervention: Account Management Call=500; Executive Outreach=1000; Customer Success Check-in=200; Personalized Email Campaign=50; Product Adoption Workshop=300; Lifecycle-specific Campaign=100; otherwise=25. - risk_assessment_timestamp = current execution timestamp with time zone. - Final filter: include only rows with non-null primary_email. - Ordering: sort by critical_alert_flag (descending), then customer_priority_score (descending), potential_revenue_loss (descending), and total_risk_score (descending).

agent_sql.raw_text:
with mapping as (select * from marts.customer360__mapping), addresses as (
 select m.customer360_id,'marketo' as source_system,'primary' as address_type,s.address_line_1,s.address_line_2,s.city,s.state_code,s.country_code,s.postal_code,1 as priority
 from mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo s on m.marketo_lead_id=s.lead_id where s.address_line_1 is not null
 union all select m.customer360_id,'marketo','billing',s.billing_address_line_1,s.billing_address_line_2,s.billing_city,s.billing_state_code,s.billing_country_code,s.billing_postal_code,2
 from mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo s on m.marketo_lead_id=s.lead_id where s.billing_address_line_1 is not null
 union all select m.customer360_id,'stripe','customer',s.customer_address_line_1,s.customer_address_line_2,s.customer_city,s.customer_state_code,s.customer_country_code,s.customer_postal_code,1
 from mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on m.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id where s.customer_address_line_1 is not null
 union all select m.customer360_id,'stripe','shipping',s.shipping_address_line_1,s.shipping_address_line_2,s.shipping_city,s.shipping_state_code,s.shipping_country_code,s.shipping_postal_code,2
 from mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on m.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id where s.shipping_address_line_1 is not null
), enriched as (
 select a.*, st.state_territory as state,cc.country_name as country,cc.alternative_country_name as country_alt_name
 from addresses a left join staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes st on a.state_code=st.state_code and a.country_code=st.alpha2_country_code
 left join staging.stg_customer360__country_codes cc on a.country_code=cc.country_code_alpha_2
)
select customer360_id,source_system,address_type,address_line_1,address_line_2,city,state_code,state,country_code,country,country_alt_name,postal_code,priority,
 row_number() over(partition by customer360_id order by priority) as rank from enriched

- name: customer360__address
      description: Consolidated customer addresses from Marketo and Stripe enriched with standardized country/state names and priority-based ranking
      grain: One row per sourced address per customer360_id (duplicates preserved)
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - staging.stg_customer360__country_codes
      - staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes
      business_logic: '- Read pass-through datasets: - marts.customer360__mapping as mapping (provides marketo_lead_id and stripe_customer_id per customer360_id) - staging.stg_customer360__country_codes as country_codes - staging.stg_customer360__state_territory_codes as state_codes - Build Marketo addresses (inner join mapping.marketo_lead_id = int_customer360__marketo.lead_id): - Primary address: include rows where address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "marketo", address_type = "primary", priority = 1; select address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state_code, country_code, postal_code - Billing address: include rows where billing_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "marketo", address_type = "billing", priority = 2; map billing_* fields to output columns - Build Stripe addresses (inner join mapping.stripe_customer_id = int_customer360__stripe.customer_id): - Customer address: include rows where customer_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "stripe", address_type = "customer", priority = 1; map customer_* fields - Shipping address: include rows where shipping_address_line_1 is not NULL; set source_system = "stripe", address_type = "shipping", priority = 2; map shipping_* fields - Union all Marketo and Stripe address rows; no de-duplication; only addresses with non-NULL address_line_1 are included. - Enrich with geographic names via left joins: - state: join state_codes on (state_code AND country_code) to derive state_territory; unmatched → NULL - country and country_alt_name: join country_codes on alpha-2 country code; unmatched → NULL - Compute rank: per customer360_id, assign row numbers ordered by priority ascending; within the same priority, order is unspecified and non-deterministic. - Output passes through source text as-is (casing/whitespace preserved); no normalization beyond the joins.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer key from mapping used to group and rank addresses; multiple rows per customer360_id
      - name: source_system
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Origin system literal ('marketo' or 'stripe'); set per source and always non-null
      - name: address_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Address category set per source: Marketo → ''primary'' or ''billing''; Stripe → ''customer'' or ''shipping'''
      - name: address_line_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary address line; rows are included only when this is non-null; text is passed through without trimming or case changes
      - name: address_line_2
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary address line from source; may be null; text is passed through without trimming or case changes
      - name: city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from source; may be null; no transformation
      - name: state_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/province code from source used for state name enrichment; may be null; case preserved
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved state/territory name from stg_customer360__state_territory_codes via (state_code,country_code) match; null if no match
      - name: country_code
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: ISO alpha-2 country code from source used for joins; may be null; case preserved
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolved country name from stg_customer360__country_codes via country_code_alpha_2; null if no match
      - name: country_alt_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alternative country name from stg_customer360__country_codes; null if no match
      - name: postal_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Postal code from source stored as BIGINT; may be null; numeric-only storage means leading zeros are not preserved
      - name: priority
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Address priority set by source (1 for primary/customer, 2 for billing/shipping); lower number indicates higher priority
      - name: rank
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Row number per customer360_id ordered by priority ascending; ties within the same priority have arbitrary order
