with base as (
 select ba.*,lm.lifecycle_stage,lm.customer_health_score,lm.estimated_customer_ltv,lm.customer_tier,
 am.activity_grade,am.weighted_engagement_score,am.primary_engagement_channel
 from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis ba left join intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics lm using(primary_email)
 left join marts.customer360__customer_activity_metrics am using(primary_email) where ba.primary_email is not null
), stage as (
 select *,in_marketo as reached_awareness,in_stripe as reached_conversion,in_zendesk as reached_support,
 case when in_marketo=1 and in_stripe=1 and in_zendesk=1 then 3 when in_marketo+in_stripe+in_zendesk>=2 then 2 when in_marketo+in_stripe+in_zendesk=1 then 1 else 0 end as journey_completeness_score,
 case when marketing_to_sales_days is null then 'Direct to Sales' when marketing_to_sales_days<=30 then 'Fast' when marketing_to_sales_days<=90 then 'Medium' when marketing_to_sales_days<=180 then 'Slow' else 'Very Slow' end as awareness_to_conversion_speed,
 case when sales_to_support_days is null then 'No Support Needed' when sales_to_support_days<=7 then 'Immediate' when sales_to_support_days<=30 then 'Quick' when sales_to_support_days<=90 then 'Standard' else 'Delayed' end as conversion_to_support_speed,
 case when marketing_to_sales_days is null then 'Direct to Sales' when marketing_to_sales_days<=60 then 'High Efficiency' when marketing_to_sales_days<=120 then 'Medium Efficiency' else 'Low Efficiency' end as funnel_efficiency,
 case when in_marketo=1 and in_stripe=1 and marketing_to_sales_days<=60 then 'High Efficiency' when in_marketo=1 and in_stripe=1 and marketing_to_sales_days<=120 then 'Medium Efficiency' when in_marketo=1 and in_stripe=1 then 'Low Efficiency' when in_stripe=1 and in_marketo=0 then 'Direct Conversion' else 'No Conversion' end as funnel_efficiency_full
 from base
), metrics as (
 select *,case when reached_awareness=1 and reached_conversion=0 then case when marketo_engagement>=4 and customer_health_score>=4 then .85 when marketo_engagement>=3 and customer_health_score>=3.5 then .70 when marketo_engagement>=2 and customer_health_score>=3 then .55 when marketo_engagement>=1 then .35 else .15 end
 when reached_conversion=1 and reached_support=0 then case when stripe_engagement>=4 and customer_tier in ('Platinum','Gold') then .75 when stripe_engagement>=3 and customer_tier in ('Gold','Silver') then .60 when stripe_engagement>=2 then .45 else .25 end else 1.00 end::decimal(3,2) as next_stage_conversion_probability,
 case when journey_completeness_score>=2 then (coalesce(marketo_engagement,0)+coalesce(stripe_engagement,0)+coalesce(zendesk_engagement,0))::double/journey_completeness_score else coalesce(marketo_engagement,stripe_engagement,zendesk_engagement,0)::double end as cross_stage_engagement_consistency,
 case when in_stripe=1 then estimated_customer_ltv*30.0/greatest(coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,30),30) else 0 end as revenue_velocity_monthly,
 case when reached_awareness=1 and reached_conversion=0 and account_age_days>180 then 'High Drop-off Risk' when reached_awareness=1 and reached_conversion=0 and marketo_engagement<=2 then 'Medium Drop-off Risk' when reached_conversion=1 and reached_support=0 and stripe_engagement<=2 then 'Support Adoption Risk' else 'Low Drop-off Risk' end as drop_off_risk,
 case when reached_conversion=1 and estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed='Fast' then 'Quick Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 and estimated_customer_ltv>=2000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed in ('Fast','Medium') then 'Standard Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 and awareness_to_conversion_speed in ('Slow','Very Slow') then 'Delayed Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 then 'Unknown Value Timeline' else 'Pre-Value Stage' end as value_realization_pattern,
 case when journey_completeness_score=3 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=60 then 'Accelerated Journey' when journey_completeness_score>=2 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=120 then 'Standard Journey' when journey_completeness_score>=1 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=300 then 'Slow Journey' else 'Stalled Journey' end as journey_velocity
 from stage
), prepared as (
 select *,case when journey_completeness_score=3 and journey_velocity='Accelerated Journey' then 'A+' when journey_completeness_score=3 and journey_velocity='Standard Journey' then 'A' when journey_completeness_score=2 and cross_stage_engagement_consistency>=3.5 then 'B+' when journey_completeness_score=2 and cross_stage_engagement_consistency>=3 then 'B' when journey_completeness_score=1 and next_stage_conversion_probability>=.6 then 'C+' when journey_completeness_score=1 and next_stage_conversion_probability>=.4 then 'C' when journey_completeness_score=1 then 'D' else 'F' end as funnel_performance_grade,
 case when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.7 and estimated_customer_ltv>=3000 then 'Critical Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.6 or estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 'High Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.4 then 'Medium Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.2 then 'Low Priority' else 'Monitor Only' end as intervention_priority
 from metrics
), enriched as (
 select *,round(estimated_customer_ltv*(next_stage_conversion_probability-(case when drop_off_risk<>'Low Drop-off Risk' then next_stage_conversion_probability*.7 else next_stage_conversion_probability*.9 end))*case when estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 1 when estimated_customer_ltv>=2000 then .8 when estimated_customer_ltv>=1000 then .6 else .4 end,2) as expected_optimization_value,
 case when drop_off_risk='Low Drop-off Risk' then .9 when drop_off_risk='Support Adoption Risk' then .7 when drop_off_risk='Medium Drop-off Risk' then .5 else .2 end as drop_weight
 from prepared
)
select marketo_lead_id,stripe_customer_id,zendesk_user_id,primary_email,primary_organization,customer_segment,customer_tier,lifecycle_stage,
 reached_awareness,reached_conversion,reached_support,journey_completeness_score,customer_journey_pattern,funnel_efficiency_full as funnel_efficiency,marketing_to_sales_days,sales_to_support_days,
 awareness_to_conversion_speed,conversion_to_support_speed,journey_velocity,revenue_velocity_monthly,marketo_engagement as awareness_engagement_quality,stripe_engagement as conversion_engagement_quality,zendesk_engagement as support_engagement_quality,
 round(cross_stage_engagement_consistency,2) as cross_stage_engagement_consistency,weighted_engagement_score,primary_engagement_channel,next_stage_conversion_probability,
 round(.4*next_stage_conversion_probability+.3*drop_weight+.3*(cross_stage_engagement_consistency/5),3) as predictive_full_journey_probability,drop_off_risk,value_realization_pattern,
 case when awareness_to_conversion_speed in ('Slow','Very Slow') and reached_conversion=0 then case when marketo_engagement>=3 then 'Accelerate Sales Qualification Process' else 'Improve Marketing Lead Quality' end
 when conversion_to_support_speed='Delayed' and reached_support=0 then 'Enhance Customer Success Onboarding' when cross_stage_engagement_consistency<2.5 then 'Implement Cross-Channel Coordination' when journey_velocity='Stalled Journey' then 'Reduce Funnel Friction Points' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.7 then 'Accelerate High-Probability Conversions' when drop_off_risk='High Drop-off Risk' then 'Implement Retention Intervention' else 'Standard Funnel Management' end as optimization_recommendation,
 expected_optimization_value,intervention_priority,
 case when journey_completeness_score=3 then 'Maintain Full Journey Excellence' when journey_completeness_score=2 and next_stage_conversion_probability>=.6 then 'Complete Journey Progression' when journey_completeness_score=1 and drop_off_risk='Low Drop-off Risk' then 'Advance to Next Stage' when drop_off_risk in ('High Drop-off Risk','Medium Drop-off Risk') then 'Prevent Drop-off' else 'Engage and Qualify' end as success_target,
 funnel_performance_grade,round(.3*journey_completeness_score+.3*case journey_velocity when 'Accelerated Journey' then 5 when 'Standard Journey' then 4 when 'Slow Journey' then 2 else 1 end+.4*cross_stage_engagement_consistency,2) as journey_efficiency_index,
 activity_grade,customer_health_score,estimated_customer_ltv,account_age_days,customer_first_touchpoint,customer_last_activity,current_timestamp as funnel_analysis_timestamp
from enriched order by intervention_priority desc,expected_optimization_value desc,journey_efficiency_index desc,predictive_full_journey_probability desc

 case when journey_completeness_score>=2 then (coalesce(marketo_engagement,0)+coalesce(stripe_engagement,0)+coalesce(zendesk_engagement,0))::double/journey_completeness_score else coalesce(marketo_engagement,stripe_engagement,zendesk_engagement,0)::double end as cross_stage_engagement_consistency,
 case when in_stripe=1 then estimated_customer_ltv*30.0/greatest(coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,30),30) else 0 end as revenue_velocity_monthly,
 case when reached_awareness=1 and reached_conversion=0 and account_age_days>180 then 'High Drop-off Risk' when reached_awareness=1 and reached_conversion=0 and marketo_engagement<=2 then 'Medium Drop-off Risk' when reached_conversion=1 and reached_support=0 and stripe_engagement<=2 then 'Support Adoption Risk' else 'Low Drop-off Risk' end as drop_off_risk,
 case when reached_conversion=1 and estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed='Fast' then 'Quick Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 and estimated_customer_ltv>=2000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed in ('Fast','Medium') then 'Standard Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 and awareness_to_conversion_speed in ('Slow','Very Slow') then 'Delayed Value Realization' when reached_conversion=1 then 'Unknown Value Timeline' else 'Pre-Value Stage' end as value_realization_pattern,
 case when journey_completeness_score=3 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=60 then 'Accelerated Journey' when journey_completeness_score>=2 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=120 then 'Standard Journey' when journey_completeness_score>=1 and coalesce(marketing_to_sales_days,0)+coalesce(sales_to_support_days,0)<=300 then 'Slow Journey' else 'Stalled Journey' end as journey_velocity
 from stage
), prepared as (
 select *,case when journey_completeness_score=3 and journey_velocity='Accelerated Journey' then 'A+' when journey_completeness_score=3 and journey_velocity='Standard Journey' then 'A' when journey_completeness_score=2 and cross_stage_engagement_consistency>=3.5 then 'B+' when journey_completeness_score=2 and cross_stage_engagement_consistency>=3 then 'B' when journey_completeness_score=1 and next_stage_conversion_probability>=.6 then 'C+' when journey_completeness_score=1 and next_stage_conversion_probability>=.4 then 'C' when journey_completeness_score=1 then 'D' else 'F' end as funnel_performance_grade,
 case when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.7 and estimated_customer_ltv>=3000 then 'Critical Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.6 or estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 'High Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.4 then 'Medium Priority' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.2 then 'Low Priority' else 'Monitor Only' end as intervention_priority
 from metrics
), enriched as (

 reached_awareness,reached_conversion,reached_support,journey_completeness_score,customer_journey_pattern,funnel_efficiency_full as funnel_efficiency,marketing_to_sales_days,sales_to_support_days,

 round(.4*next_stage_conversion_probability+.3*drop_weight+.3*(cross_stage_engagement_consistency/5),3) as predictive_full_journey_probability,drop_off_risk,value_realization_pattern,
 case when awareness_to_conversion_speed in ('Slow','Very Slow') and reached_conversion=0 then case when marketo_engagement>=3 then 'Accelerate Sales Qualification Process' else 'Improve Marketing Lead Quality' end
 when conversion_to_support_speed='Delayed' and reached_support=0 then 'Enhance Customer Success Onboarding' when cross_stage_engagement_consistency<2.5 then 'Implement Cross-Channel Coordination' when journey_velocity='Stalled Journey' then 'Reduce Funnel Friction Points' when next_stage_conversion_probability>=.7 then 'Accelerate High-Probability Conversions' when drop_off_risk='High Drop-off Risk' then 'Implement Retention Intervention' else 'Standard Funnel Management' end as optimization_recommendation,
 expected_optimization_value,intervention_priority,
 case when journey_completeness_score=3 then 'Maintain Full Journey Excellence' when journey_completeness_score=2 and next_stage_conversion_probability>=.6 then 'Complete Journey Progression' when journey_completeness_score=1 and drop_off_risk='Low Drop-off Risk' then 'Advance to Next Stage' when drop_off_risk in ('High Drop-off Risk','Medium Drop-off Risk') then 'Prevent Drop-off' else 'Engage and Qualify' end as success_target,
 funnel_performance_grade,round(.3*journey_completeness_score+.3*case journey_velocity when 'Accelerated Journey' then 5 when 'Standard Journey' then 4 when 'Slow Journey' then 2 else 1 end+.4*cross_stage_engagement_consistency,2) as journey_efficiency_index,

cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, CASE WHEN journey_completeness_score = 3 AND journey_velocity = 'Accelerated Journey' THEN 'A+' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 3 AND journey_velocity = 'Standard Journey' THEN 'A' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 2 AND cross_stage_engagement_consistency >= 3.5 THEN 'B+' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 2 AND cross_stage_engagement_consistency >= 3 THEN 'B' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 1 AND next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.6 THEN 'C+' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 1 AND next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.4 THEN 'C' WHEN journey_completeness_score = 1 THEN 'D' ELSE 'F' END AS funnel_performance_grade, CASE WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.7 AND estimated_customer_ltv >= 3000 THEN 'Critical Priority' WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.6 OR estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 'High Priority' WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.4 THEN 'Medium Priority' WHEN next_stage_conversion_probability >= 0.2 THEN 'Low Priority' ELSE 'Monitor Only' END AS intervention_priority FROM metrics

cte_definitions.name: enriched
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, ROUND(estimated_customer_ltv * (next_stage_conversion_probability - (CASE WHEN drop_off_risk <> 'Low Drop-off Risk' THEN next_stage_conversion_probability * 0.7 ELSE next_stage_conversion_probability * 0.9 END)) * CASE WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 5000 THEN 1 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 2000 THEN 0.8 WHEN estimated_customer_ltv >= 1000 THEN 0.6 ELSE 0.4 END, 2) AS expected_optimization_value, CASE WHEN drop_off_risk = 'Low Drop-off Risk' THEN 0.9 WHEN drop_off_risk = 'Support Adoption Risk' THEN 0.7 WHEN drop_off_risk = 'Medium Drop-off Risk' THEN 0.5 ELSE 0.2 END AS drop_weight FROM prepared

      description: Conversion funnel metrics and optimization insights derived from behavior, lifecycle, and activity sources
      grain: One row per behavior_analysis record with non-null primary_email

      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, primary_email, primary_organization, customer_first_touchpoint, customer_last_activity, customer_journey_pattern, customer_segment, marketing_to_sales_days, sales_to_support_days, account_age_days, in_marketo, in_stripe, in_zendesk, marketo_engagement, stripe_engagement, zendesk_engagement)
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (primary_email, lifecycle_stage, customer_health_score, estimated_customer_ltv, customer_tier)
      - marts.customer360__customer_activity_metrics (primary_email, activity_grade, weighted_engagement_score, primary_engagement_channel)
      business_logic: '- Begin with behavior_analysis and left join lifecycle_metrics and activity_metrics on primary_email. - Stage flags: reached_awareness = in_marketo; reached_conversion = in_stripe; reached_support = in_zendesk (1/0/NULL passthrough). - Speed buckets: awareness_to_conversion_speed from marketing_to_sales_days: ≤30 → Fast; ≤90 → Medium; ≤180 → Slow; >180 → Very Slow; missing → Direct to Sales. conversion_to_support_speed from sales_to_support_days: ≤7 → Immediate; ≤30 → Quick; ≤90 → Standard; >90 → Delayed; missing → No Support Needed. - journey_completeness_score: 3 if all three stage flags = 1; 2 if any two = 1; 1 if any one = 1; else 0. - Engagement quality passthrough: awareness_engagement_quality = marketo_engagement; conversion_engagement_quality = stripe_engagement; support_engagement_quality = zendesk_engagement. - funnel_efficiency: in_marketo = 1 and in_stripe = 1 and marketing_to_sales_days ≤ 60 → High Efficiency; same but ≤120 → Medium Efficiency; same (no day threshold) → Low Efficiency; in_stripe = 1 and in_marketo = 0 → Direct Conversion; else → No Conversion. - next_stage_conversion_probability (DECIMAL(3,2)): If reached_awareness = 1 and reached_conversion = 0: awareness_engagement_quality ≥ 4 and customer_health_score ≥ 4.0 → 0.85; ≥3 and ≥3.5 → 0.70; ≥2 and ≥3.0 → 0.55; ≥1 → 0.35; else → 0.15. Else if reached_conversion = 1 and reached_support = 0: conversion_engagement_quality ≥ 4 and customer_tier in {Platinum, Gold} → 0.75; ≥3 and customer_tier in {Gold, Silver} → 0.60; ≥2 → 0.45; else → 0.25. Else → 1.00. - value_realization_pattern: If reached_conversion = 1: estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 5000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed = Fast → Quick Value Realization; estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 2000 and awareness_to_conversion_speed in {Fast, Medium} → Standard Value Realization; awareness_to_conversion_speed in {Slow, Very Slow} → Delayed Value Realization; else → Unknown Value Timeline. Else → Pre-Value Stage. - drop_off_risk: reached_awareness = 1 and reached_conversion = 0 and account_age_days > 180 → High Drop-off Risk; reached_awareness = 1 and reached_conversion = 0 and awareness_engagement_quality ≤ 2 → Medium Drop-off Risk; reached_conversion = 1 and reached_support = 0 and conversion_engagement_quality ≤ 2 → Support Adoption Risk; else → Low Drop-off Risk. - journey_velocity: Use the sum of marketing_to_sales_days and sales_to_support_days, treating missing values as 0: completeness = 3 and sum ≤ 60 → Accelerated Journey; completeness ≥ 2 and sum ≤ 120 → Standard Journey; completeness ≥ 1 and sum ≤ 300 → Slow Journey; else → Stalled Journey. - cross_stage_engagement_consistency (DOUBLE, rounded to 2 decimals): If completeness ≥ 2: average of stage engagement scores where missing counts as 0 (sum divided by completeness). Else: use the single available score in order awareness, then conversion, then support; if none present use 0. - revenue_velocity_monthly (DOUBLE, rounded to 2 decimals): If reached_conversion = 1: monthly velocity = (estimated_customer_ltv ÷ days to sales), using 30 days when unavailable or less than 30, then ×30; else 0. Returns NULL if LTV is NULL. - optimization_recommendation: Awareness→Conversion is Slow/Very Slow and reached_conversion = 0 → if awareness_engagement_quality ≥ 3 then Accelerate Sales Qualification Process else Improve Marketing Lead Quality; Conversion→Support is Delayed and reached_support = 0 → Enhance Customer Success Onboarding; cross_stage_engagement_consistency < 2.5 → Implement Cross-Channel Coordination; journey_velocity = Stalled Journey → Reduce Funnel Friction Points; next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.7 → Accelerate High-Probability Conversions; drop_off_risk = High Drop-off Risk → Implement Retention Intervention; else → Standard Funnel Management. - expected_optimization_value (DECIMAL(18,2), rounded to 2 decimals): estimated_customer_ltv × (next_stage_conversion_probability − reduction) × tier_multiplier, where reduction = next_stage_conversion_probability × 0.7 if drop_off_risk is not Low Drop-off Risk else × 0.9, and tier_multiplier = 1.0 if LTV ≥ 5000, 0.8 if ≥2000, 0.6 if ≥1000, else 0.4. Returns NULL if LTV is NULL. - intervention_priority: next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.7 and estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 3000 → Critical Priority; next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.6 or estimated_customer_ltv ≥ 5000 → High Priority; next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.4 → Medium Priority; next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.2 → Low Priority; else → Monitor Only. - success_target: completeness = 3 → Maintain Full Journey Excellence; completeness = 2 and next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.6 → Complete Journey Progression; completeness = 1 and drop_off_risk = Low Drop-off Risk → Advance to Next Stage; drop_off_risk in {High Drop-off Risk, Medium Drop-off Risk} → Prevent Drop-off; else → Engage and Qualify. - funnel_performance_grade: completeness = 3 and journey_velocity = Accelerated Journey → A+; completeness = 3 and journey_velocity = Standard Journey → A; completeness = 2 and cross_stage_engagement_consistency ≥ 3.5 → B+; completeness = 2 and ≥ 3.0 → B; completeness = 1 and next_stage_conversion_probability ≥ 0.6 → C+; completeness = 1 and ≥ 0.4 → C; completeness = 1 → D; else → F. - journey_efficiency_index (DOUBLE, rounded to 2 decimals): 0.3 × completeness + 0.3 × velocity_score + 0.4 × cross_stage_engagement_consistency, where velocity_score = 5 for Accelerated Journey, 4 for Standard Journey, 2 for Slow Journey, else 1. - predictive_full_journey_probability (DOUBLE, rounded to 3 decimals): 0.4 × next_stage_conversion_probability + 0.3 × drop_off_weight + 0.3 × (cross_stage_engagement_consistency ÷ 5.0), where drop_off_weight = 0.9 for Low Drop-off Risk, 0.7 for Support Adoption Risk, 0.5 for Medium Drop-off Risk, else 0.2. - funnel_analysis_timestamp: set to the current system timestamp (time zone aware). - Final selection and ordering: include only records with a present primary_email; order by intervention_priority (descending lexicographic), then expected_optimization_value (descending), journey_efficiency_index (descending), predictive_full_journey_probability (descending).'

        description: Current timestamp at query execution (time zone aware); same for all rows in a run

with dimensions as (
 select m.customer360_id,m.customer360_organization_id,m.is_organization_header,m.source_ids,s.email,s.full_name,s.organization_name,
 s.address_line_1,s.address_line_2,s.city,s.state,s.country,s.country_alt_name,s.postal_code,s.ip_address,s.phone
 from marts.customer360__mapping m inner join marts.customer360__summary s using(customer360_id)
), non_headers as (
 select *,case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then 10 else 5 end::hugeint as marketing_email_sends,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then 3 else 2 end::hugeint as marketing_email_opens,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then 1 else 0 end::hugeint as marketing_email_clicks,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then 1250.00 else 750.00 end::decimal(38,2) as total_sales_amount,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then 2 else 1 end::hugeint as total_sales_count,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then date '2024-01-15' else date '2024-02-10' end as first_sale_date,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then date '2024-03-15' else date '2024-02-10' end as most_recent_sale_date,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then 3 else 1 end::hugeint as support_tickets_created,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then 2 else 1 end::hugeint as support_tickets_resolved,
 case when customer360_id='sample_customer_1' then 4.5 else 5.0 end::double as avg_satisfaction_score
 from dimensions where not is_organization_header
), headers as (
 select customer360_id,customer360_organization_id,is_organization_header,source_ids,email,full_name,organization_name,address_line_1,address_line_2,city,state,country,country_alt_name,postal_code,ip_address,phone,
 sum(0)::hugeint as marketing_email_sends,sum(0)::hugeint as marketing_email_opens,sum(0)::hugeint as marketing_email_clicks,sum(0.00)::decimal(38,2) as total_sales_amount,
 sum(0)::hugeint as total_sales_count,null::date as first_sale_date,null::date as most_recent_sale_date,sum(0)::hugeint as support_tickets_created,sum(0)::hugeint as support_tickets_resolved,avg(0.0)::double as avg_satisfaction_score
 from dimensions where is_organization_header group by all
)
select * from non_headers union all select * from headers

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__customer
      description: Unified customer and organization header profile with pass-through attributes and deterministic sample metrics/aggregations.
      grain: One row per customer360_id
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - marts.customer360__summary
      business_logic: '1) Build a dimensions set by inner joining marts.customer360__mapping to marts.customer360__summary on customer360_id, selecting: customer360_organization_id, is_organization_header, source_ids (from mapping) and email, full_name, organization_name, address_line_1, address_line_2, city, state, country, country_alt_name, postal_code, ip_address, phone (from summary). Only ids present in both sources are kept; all fields are passed through as stored. 2) For non-organization headers (is_organization_header = FALSE), assign sample metrics per customer360_id: - For ''sample_customer_1'': sends=10, opens=3, clicks=1, sales_amount=1250.00, sales_count=2, first_sale_date=2024-01-15, most_recent_sale_date=2024-03-15, tickets_created=3, tickets_resolved=2, avg_satisfaction=4.5. - For all others: sends=5, opens=2, clicks=0, sales_amount=750.00, sales_count=1, first_sale_date=2024-02-10, most_recent_sale_date=2024-02-10, tickets_created=1, tickets_resolved=1, avg_satisfaction=5.0. 3) Combine dimensions with these metrics by customer360_id. For rows without assigned metrics (headers), set numeric metrics to 0 (including avg_satisfaction_score) and leave first_sale_date and most_recent_sale_date as NULL. 4) For organization headers only, produce one row per unique header by aggregating the combined dataset across the header’s own rows: sum email sends/opens/clicks, sum sales amount and sales count, take the earliest first_sale_date, the latest most_recent_sale_date, sum tickets created/resolved, and average the satisfaction score. Aggregations consider only header rows (child/customer rows are not included in header rollups); standard null handling applies to aggregates (nulls are ignored in averages; earliest/latest dates return NULL if all inputs are NULL). 5) Output includes all non-header rows from step 3 and the aggregated header rows from step 4 appended together. No specific output ordering is enforced.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary identifier; one output row per id; also the join key between mapping and summary.
      - name: customer360_organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Organization identifier from mapping; passed through unchanged.

        description: TRUE for organization headers (included via header aggregation), FALSE for individual/non-header customers (receive sample metrics).

        description: Address line 1 from summary; passed through.
      - name: address_line_2

        description: Address line 2 from summary; passed through.
      - name: city
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: City from summary; passed through.
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/region from summary; passed through.
      - name: country
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country from summary; passed through.
      - name: country_alt_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Alternative country name from summary; passed through.
      - name: postal_code
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Postal/ZIP code from summary stored as numeric; passed through.
      - name: ip_address
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: IP address from summary; passed through.
      - name: phone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Phone number from summary; passed through.
      - name: marketing_email_sends
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Count of marketing emails sent; non-headers: 10 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 5; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: marketing_email_opens
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Count of marketing email opens; non-headers: 3 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 2; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: marketing_email_clicks
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Count of marketing email clicks; non-headers: 1 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 0; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: total_sales_amount
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,2)
        description: 'Total sales amount; non-headers: 1250.00 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 750.00; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.00.'
      - name: total_sales_count
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: 'Total number of sales; non-headers: 2 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 1; headers: summed across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.'
      - name: first_sale_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: 'First sale date; non-headers: 2024-01-15 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 2024-02-10; headers: earliest across header rows; NULL if no non-NULL values.'
      - name: most_recent_sale_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: 'Most recent sale date; non-headers: 2024-03-15 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 2024-02-10; headers: latest across header rows; NULL if no non-NULL values.'
      - name: support_tickets_created

        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Average satisfaction score; non-headers: 4.5 for ''sample_customer_1'' else 5.0; headers: averaged across header rows; missing metrics default to 0.0.'

agent_sql.raw_text:
with base as (
 select ba.*,lm.lifecycle_stage,lm.customer_health_score,lm.active_30_days,lm.active_60_days,lm.active_90_days,lm.active_180_days,lm.active_365_days,lm.account_age_days,
 m.is_unsubscribed,m.is_email_invalid,m.do_not_call,m.updated_at as m_updated,s.is_delinquent,s.is_deleted as stripe_deleted,s.updated_at as s_updated,
 z.is_active as zendesk_active,z.is_suspended as zendesk_suspended,z.is_deleted as zendesk_deleted,z.updated_at as z_updated,
 m.created_at as marketo_registration_date,s.created_at as stripe_registration_date,z.created_at as zendesk_registration_date,
 m.email as m_email,s.email as s_email,z.email as z_email
 from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis ba
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics lm using(primary_email)
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo m on ba.marketo_lead_id=m.lead_id
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on ba.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk z on ba.zendesk_user_id=z.user_id
 where ba.primary_email is not null
), recency as (
 select *,date_diff('day',customer_last_activity,current_date)::bigint as days_since_last_activity,
 (in_marketo+in_stripe+in_zendesk)::integer as active_channel_count,
 case when customer_last_activity is null then null else date_diff('week',customer_last_activity,current_date)::bigint end as weeks_since_last_activity,
 case when customer_last_activity is null then null else date_diff('month',customer_last_activity,current_date)::bigint end as months_since_last_activity
 from base
), channels as (
 select *,case when in_marketo=1 and is_unsubscribed=false and is_email_invalid=false then round(marketo_engagement*(1-date_diff('day',m_updated,current_timestamp)/90.0),2) else 0 end as marketing_engagement_score,
 case when in_stripe=1 and stripe_deleted=false and is_delinquent=false then round(stripe_engagement*(1-date_diff('day',s_updated,current_timestamp)/60.0),2) else 0 end as sales_engagement_score,
 case when in_zendesk=1 and zendesk_active=true and zendesk_suspended=false and zendesk_deleted=false then round(zendesk_engagement*(1-date_diff('day',z_updated,current_timestamp)/120.0),2) else 0 end as support_engagement_score,
 case when days_since_last_activity<=7 and composite_engagement_score>=3 then 'Accelerating' when days_since_last_activity<=14 and composite_engagement_score>=2.5 then 'Steady High'
 when days_since_last_activity<=30 and composite_engagement_score>=2 then 'Steady Medium' when days_since_last_activity<=60 then 'Declining' when days_since_last_activity<=90 then 'Slow' else 'Stagnant' end as engagement_velocity,
 case when days_since_last_activity<=7 and composite_engagement_score>=3.5 then 'High Momentum' when days_since_last_activity<=14 and composite_engagement_score>=3 then 'Medium Momentum'
 when days_since_last_activity<=30 and composite_engagement_score>=2 then 'Low Momentum' when days_since_last_activity<=60 then 'Losing Momentum' else 'No Momentum' end as activity_momentum
 from recency
), scores as (
 select *,round(coalesce(marketing_engagement_score,0)*.3+coalesce(sales_engagement_score,0)*.5+coalesce(support_engagement_score,0)*.2,2) as weighted_engagement_score,
 case when marketing_engagement_score>=sales_engagement_score and marketing_engagement_score>=support_engagement_score then 'Marketing Driven'
 when sales_engagement_score>=support_engagement_score then 'Sales Driven' when support_engagement_score is not null then 'Support Driven' else 'Balanced' end as primary_engagement_channel,
 case when in_marketo=1 then case when marketo_engagement>=4 then 'Deep' when marketo_engagement>=2 then 'Medium' else 'Shallow' end else 'None' end as marketing_depth,
 case when in_stripe=1 then case when stripe_engagement>=4 then 'Deep' when stripe_engagement>=2 then 'Medium' else 'Shallow' end else 'None' end as sales_depth,
 case when in_zendesk=1 then case when zendesk_engagement>=4 then 'Deep' when zendesk_engagement>=2 then 'Medium' else 'Shallow' end else 'None' end as support_depth,
 case when account_age_days>=365 and active_channel_count>=3 then 'Mature Multi-channel' when account_age_days>=180 and active_channel_count>=2 then 'Developing Multi-channel'

SELECT *, ROUND(COALESCE(marketing_engagement_score, 0) * 0.3 + COALESCE(sales_engagement_score, 0) * 0.5 + COALESCE(support_engagement_score, 0) * 0.2, 2) AS weighted_engagement_score, CASE WHEN marketing_engagement_score >= sales_engagement_score AND marketing_engagement_score >= support_engagement_score THEN 'Marketing Driven' WHEN sales_engagement_score >= support_engagement_score THEN 'Sales Driven' WHEN NOT support_engagement_score IS NULL THEN 'Support Driven' ELSE 'Balanced' END AS primary_engagement_channel, CASE WHEN in_marketo = 1 THEN CASE WHEN marketo_engagement >= 4 THEN 'Deep' WHEN marketo_engagement >= 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Shallow' END ELSE 'None' END AS marketing_depth, CASE WHEN in_stripe = 1 THEN CASE WHEN stripe_engagement >= 4 THEN 'Deep' WHEN stripe_engagement >= 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Shallow' END ELSE 'None' END AS sales_depth, CASE WHEN in_zendesk = 1 THEN CASE WHEN zendesk_engagement >= 4 THEN 'Deep' WHEN zendesk_engagement >= 2 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Shallow' END ELSE 'None' END AS support_depth, CASE WHEN account_age_days >= 365 AND active_channel_count >= 3 THEN 'Mature Multi-channel' WHEN account_age_days >= 180 AND active_channel_count >= 2 THEN 'Developing Multi-channel' WHEN account_age_days >= 90 AND active_channel_count >= 1 THEN 'Single Channel Engaged' WHEN account_age_days < 90 THEN 'Early Stage' ELSE 'Minimal Engagement' END AS engagement_maturity, CASE WHEN composite_engagement_score >= 4 THEN 15 + FLOOR(RANDOM() * 10) WHEN composite_engagement_score >= 3 THEN 8 + FLOOR(RANDOM() * 7) WHEN composite_engagement_score >= 2 THEN 3 + FLOOR(RANDOM() * 5) WHEN composite_engagement_score >= 1 THEN 1 + FLOOR(RANDOM() * 3) ELSE FLOOR(RANDOM() * 2) END AS estimated_monthly_activities FROM channels

SELECT *, ROUND(composite_engagement_score / NULLIF(active_channel_count, 0), 2) AS activity_efficiency, ROUND(CASE WHEN in_marketo = 1 THEN marketo_engagement ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN in_stripe = 1 THEN stripe_engagement ELSE 0 END + CASE WHEN in_zendesk = 1 THEN zendesk_engagement ELSE 0 END, 2) AS cross_platform_consistency, CASE WHEN weighted_engagement_score >= 4 AND active_channel_count >= 3 THEN 'A+' WHEN weighted_engagement_score >= 3.5 AND active_channel_count >= 2 THEN 'A' WHEN weighted_engagement_score >= 3 THEN 'B+' WHEN weighted_engagement_score >= 2.5 THEN 'B' WHEN weighted_engagement_score >= 2 THEN 'C+' WHEN weighted_engagement_score >= 1.5 THEN 'C' WHEN weighted_engagement_score >= 1 THEN 'D' ELSE 'F' END AS activity_grade, ROUND(0.4 * weighted_engagement_score + 0.3 * active_channel_count + 0.3 * CASE WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 7 AND composite_engagement_score >= 3.5 THEN 5 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 14 AND composite_engagement_score >= 3 THEN 4 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 30 AND composite_engagement_score >= 2 THEN 3 WHEN days_since_last_activity <= 60 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END, 2) AS activity_priority_score FROM scores

cte_definitions.name: base
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT ba.*, lm.lifecycle_stage, lm.customer_health_score, lm.active_30_days, lm.active_60_days, lm.active_90_days, lm.active_180_days, lm.active_365_days, lm.account_age_days, m.is_unsubscribed, m.is_email_invalid, m.do_not_call, m.updated_at AS m_updated, s.is_delinquent, s.is_deleted AS stripe_deleted, s.updated_at AS s_updated, z.is_active AS zendesk_active, z.is_suspended AS zendesk_suspended, z.is_deleted AS zendesk_deleted, z.updated_at AS z_updated, m.created_at AS marketo_registration_date, s.created_at AS stripe_registration_date, z.created_at AS zendesk_registration_date, m.email AS m_email, s.email AS s_email, z.email AS z_email FROM intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis AS ba LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics AS lm USING (primary_email) LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_customer360__marketo AS m ON ba.marketo_lead_id = m.lead_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_customer360__stripe AS s ON ba.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk AS z ON ba.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id WHERE NOT ba.primary_email IS NULL

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__customer_activity_metrics
      description: Customer activity and engagement metrics across marketing, sales, and support with recency, velocity, depth, risk, and intervention signals
      grain: One row per primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: 'Overview - Start from behavior_analysis (intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis, one row per customer) and left join lifecycle_metrics (intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics) on primary_email. - Enrich with platform data via left joins on platform IDs: - Marketo: intermediate.int_customer360__marketo on lead_id - Stripe: intermediate.int_customer360__stripe on customer_id - Zendesk: intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk on user_id - Filter: exclude rows where primary_email is NULL; no de-duplication beyond joins. - Time anchors: current_date for recency calculations and current_timestamp for activity_analysis_timestamp; results vary by execution time. - Ordering: rows are sorted by activity_priority_score (desc), then weighted_engagement_score (desc), then active_channel_count (desc). Activity recency and counts - days/weeks/months_since_last_activity: difference between customer_last_activity and current_date by unit; returns NULL if customer_last_activity is NULL. - active_channel_count: integer sum (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk); if any flag is NULL the sum becomes NULL; expected domain is 0–3 from 0/1 flags. Estimated and adjusted activity (stochastic components) - estimated_monthly_activities: simulated with random() per run based on composite_engagement_score: - >=4.0 → 15 + floor(random()*10) ∈ [15,24] - >=3.0 → 8 + floor(random()*7) ∈ [8,14] - >=2.0 → 3 + floor(random()*5) ∈ [3,7] - >=1.0 → 1 + floor(random()*3) ∈ [1,3] - else → floor(random()*2) ∈ [0,1] - Note: random() yields different results each execution; this column is non-deterministic by design. - seasonally_adjusted_activity: estimated_monthly_activities multiplied by a month factor (Nov/Dec/Jan ×1.2; Jun/Jul/Aug ×0.8; else ×1.0); no rounding. - predicted_next_month_activity: estimated_monthly_activities multiplied by a factor from engagement_velocity category (Accelerating ×1.3; Steady High ×1.1; Steady Medium ×1.0; Declining ×0.7; Slow ×0.4; Stagnant ×0.2); no rounding. Engagement velocity, momentum, maturity (rule-based categories) - engagement_velocity (uses activity recency and composite_engagement_score): - <=7 days and score>=3.0 → Accelerating - <=14 days and score>=2.5 → Steady High - <=30 days and score>=2.0 → Steady Medium - <=60 days → Declining - <=90 days → Slow - else → Stagnant - activity_momentum (uses days_since_last_activity and composite_engagement_score): - <=7 days and score>=3.5 → High Momentum - <=14 days and score>=3.0 → Medium Momentum - <=30 days and score>=2.0 → Low Momentum - <=60 days → Losing Momentum - else → No Momentum - engagement_maturity (uses account_age_days and active_channel_count): - age>=365 and channels>=3 → Mature Multi-channel - age>=180 and channels>=2 → Developing Multi-channel - age>=90 and channels>=1 → Single Channel Engaged - age<90 → Early Stage - else → Minimal Engagement Channel scores and depths - marketing_engagement_score: if in_marketo=1 and is_unsubscribed=false and is_email_invalid=false then round(marketo_engagement × (1 − days since last Marketo update / 90), 2); else 0; may be negative; if the last update timestamp is NULL the result is NULL in the true branch. - sales_engagement_score: if in_stripe=1 and is_deleted=false and is_delinquent=false then round(stripe_engagement × (1 − days since last Stripe update / 60), 2); else 0; may be negative; NULL if the last update timestamp is NULL in the true branch. - support_engagement_score: if in_zendesk=1 and is_active=true and is_suspended=false and is_deleted=false then round(zendesk_engagement × (1 − days since last Zendesk update / 120), 2); else 0; may be negative; NULL if the last update timestamp is NULL in the true branch. - primary_engagement_channel: choose the channel with the highest raw engagement; ties break in order Marketing Driven > Sales Driven > Support Driven; if comparisons do not resolve (e.g., NULL inputs) fallback is Balanced. - marketing_depth/sales_depth/support_depth (per channel): if in_* = 1: engagement>=4 → Deep; engagement>=2 → Medium; else → Shallow; if in_*=0 → None. Cross-platform and composite scores - cross_platform_consistency: round( average of raw engagement across platforms where in_*=1, 2 decimals ); returns NULL if no active platforms or if any included operand (flags or raw engagements) is NULL. - activity_efficiency: round(composite_engagement_score divided by active_channel_count, 2); NULL if active_channel_count is 0 or NULL. - weighted_engagement_score: round(0.3×marketing_engagement_score (NULL→0) + 0.5×sales_engagement_score (NULL→0) + 0.2×support_engagement_score (NULL→0), 2); can be negative. - activity_grade: from weighted_engagement_score and active_channel_count: >=4.0 & channels>=3 → A+; >=3.5 & channels>=2 → A; >=3.0 → B+; >=2.5 → B; >=2.0 → C+; >=1.5 → C; >=1.0 → D; else → F. - activity_priority_score: round(0.4×weighted_engagement_score + 0.3×active_channel_count + 0.3×priority_component, 2) where priority_component is 5/4/3/2/1 by recency+composite rules (<=7 days & score>=3.5 → 5; <=14 & score>=3.0 → 4; <=30 & score>=2.0 → 3; <=60 → 2; else → 1). Risk and interventions - activity_risk_level: if days_since_last_activity>90 and customer_health_score<3.0 → High Activity Risk; else if days_since_last_activity>60 or active_channel_count=1 → Medium Activity Risk; else if days_since_last_activity>30 → Low Activity Risk; else → No Activity Risk. - recommended_activity_intervention (evaluated top-to-bottom): Declining/Slow/Stagnant with health>=3.0 → Re-engagement Campaign; else single channel (count=1) with composite>=2.5 → Channel Expansion; else Marketing Driven with in_stripe=0 → Sales Conversion Focus; else Sales Driven with in_zendesk=0 → Success Onboarding; else recent (<=7 days) with composite>=3.5 → Upsell Opportunity; else Standard Engagement.'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier sourced from behavior_analysis; may be NULL if not matched
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier sourced from behavior_analysis; may be NULL if not matched
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier sourced from behavior_analysis; may be NULL if not matched
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer email key; rows with NULL are excluded from output; grain is one row per primary_email
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer organization from behavior_analysis; passthrough value
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer segment from behavior_analysis; passthrough value
      - name: customer_journey_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Journey pattern label from behavior_analysis; passthrough value
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle stage from lifecycle_metrics joined on primary_email; may be NULL
      - name: composite_engagement_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(14,1)
        description: Base composite engagement score from behavior_analysis; used by multiple downstream rules without further rounding
      - name: weighted_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 0.3*marketing_engagement_score + 0.5*sales_engagement_score + 0.2*support_engagement_score rounded to 2 decimals; NULL channel scores treated as 0; may be negative
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Health score from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough value used in risk and intervention logic
      - name: activity_grade
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Letter grade from weighted_engagement_score and active_channel_count with thresholds: A+, A, B+, B, C+, C, D, F as defined in Business Logic'
      - name: activity_priority_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Priority score rounded to 2 decimals: 0.4*weighted_engagement_score + 0.3*active_channel_count + 0.3*recency_component (5–1) per rules'
      - name: days_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of days between customer_last_activity and current_date; NULL if customer_last_activity is NULL
      - name: weeks_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of weeks between customer_last_activity and current_date; NULL if customer_last_activity is NULL
      - name: months_since_last_activity
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Number of months between customer_last_activity and current_date; NULL if customer_last_activity is NULL
      - name: account_age_days
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Account age in days from behavior_analysis; passthrough value used in maturity logic
      - name: active_channel_count
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk (expected 0–3); NULL if any flag is NULL
      - name: primary_engagement_channel
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Channel with highest raw engagement; ties break Marketing Driven > Sales Driven > Support Driven; fallback Balanced when comparisons cannot be resolved (e.g., NULL inputs)
      - name: marketing_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If in_marketo=1 and not unsubscribed/invalid then mark_engagement×(1 − days since last update/90) rounded to 2 decimals; else 0; may be negative or NULL if updated_at is NULL in the true branch
      - name: sales_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If in_stripe=1 and not deleted and not delinquent then stripe_engagement×(1 − days since last update/60) rounded to 2 decimals; else 0; may be negative or NULL if updated_at is NULL in the true branch
      - name: support_engagement_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: If in_zendesk=1 and active and not suspended/deleted then zendesk_engagement×(1 − days since last update/120) rounded to 2 decimals; else 0; may be negative or NULL if updated_at is NULL in the true branch
      - name: marketing_depth
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Depth within Marketo: if in_marketo=1 then engagement>=4 Deep, >=2 Medium, else Shallow; if in_marketo=0 then None'
      - name: sales_depth
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Depth within Stripe: if in_stripe=1 then engagement>=4 Deep, >=2 Medium, else Shallow; if in_stripe=0 then None'
      - name: support_depth
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Depth within Zendesk: if in_zendesk=1 then engagement>=4 Deep, >=2 Medium, else Shallow; if in_zendesk=0 then None'
      - name: engagement_velocity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Velocity category from recency and composite_engagement_score: Accelerating, Steady High, Steady Medium, Declining, Slow, or Stagnant per thresholds'
      - name: activity_momentum
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Momentum category from days_since_last_activity and composite_engagement_score: High/Medium/Low Momentum, Losing Momentum, or No Momentum per thresholds'
      - name: engagement_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Maturity category from account_age_days and active_channel_count: Mature Multi-channel, Developing Multi-channel, Single Channel Engaged, Early Stage, or Minimal Engagement'
      - name: estimated_monthly_activities
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Simulated integer in defined ranges using random() and composite_engagement_score; stochastic and varies each run
      - name: predicted_next_month_activity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Estimated future activity = estimated_monthly_activities × factor from engagement_velocity (1.3/1.1/1.0/0.7/0.4/0.2); not rounded
      - name: seasonally_adjusted_activity
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Estimated_monthly_activities adjusted by month: Nov–Jan ×1.2, Jun–Aug ×0.8, else ×1.0; not rounded'
      - name: active_30_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity metric for last 30 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough
      - name: active_60_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity metric for last 60 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough
      - name: active_90_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity metric for last 90 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough
      - name: active_180_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity metric for last 180 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough
      - name: active_365_days
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Activity metric for last 365 days from lifecycle_metrics; passthrough
      - name: activity_risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk category from days_since_last_activity, customer_health_score, and active_channel_count: High/Medium/Low/No Activity Risk per rules'
      - name: cross_platform_consistency
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of raw engagement across active platforms (in_*=1) rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if no active platforms or any included operand is NULL
      - name: activity_efficiency
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Composite_engagement_score divided by active_channel_count rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if denominator is 0 or NULL
      - name: recommended_activity_intervention
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Intervention label evaluated in order: Re-engagement Campaign, Channel Expansion, Sales Conversion Focus, Success Onboarding, Upsell Opportunity, else Standard Engagement'
      - name: in_marketo
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Channel presence flag from behavior_analysis (expected 0/1); used in counts and conditional logic; may be NULL
      - name: in_stripe
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Channel presence flag from behavior_analysis (expected 0/1); used in counts and conditional logic; may be NULL
      - name: in_zendesk
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Channel presence flag from behavior_analysis (expected 0/1); used in counts and conditional logic; may be NULL
      - name: is_unsubscribed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Marketo unsubscribe flag from platform data; influences marketing_engagement_score
      - name: is_email_invalid
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Marketo invalid email flag from platform data; influences marketing_engagement_score
      - name: do_not_call
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Marketo do-not-call flag from platform data; passthrough
      - name: is_delinquent
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Stripe delinquency flag from platform data; influences sales_engagement_score
      - name: stripe_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Stripe deletion flag from platform data; influences sales_engagement_score
      - name: zendesk_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk active flag from platform data; required true for support_engagement_score to be computed
      - name: zendesk_suspended
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk suspended flag from platform data; must be false for support_engagement_score to be computed
      - name: zendesk_deleted
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Zendesk deletion flag from platform data; must be false for support_engagement_score to be computed
      - name: customer_first_touchpoint
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: First touch timestamp from behavior_analysis; passthrough
      - name: customer_last_activity
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Most recent activity timestamp from behavior_analysis; drives recency metrics
      - name: marketo_registration_date
        data_type: TIMESTAMP

specification.name: customer360__customer_activity_metrics
specification.description: Customer activity and engagement metrics across marketing, sales, and support with recency, velocity, depth, risk, and intervention signals
specification.business_logic: Overview - Start from behavior_analysis (intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis, one row per customer) and left join lifecycle_metrics (intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics) on primary_email. - Enrich with platform data via left joins on platform IDs: - Marketo: intermediate.int_customer360__marketo on lead_id - Stripe: intermediate.int_customer360__stripe on customer_id - Zendesk: intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk on user_id - Filter: exclude rows where primary_email is NULL; no de-duplication beyond joins. - Time anchors: current_date for recency calculations and current_timestamp for activity_analysis_timestamp; results vary by execution time. - Ordering: rows are sorted by activity_priority_score (desc), then weighted_engagement_score (desc), then active_channel_count (desc). Activity recency and counts - days/weeks/months_since_last_activity: difference between customer_last_activity and current_date by unit; returns NULL if customer_last_activity is NULL. - active_channel_count: integer sum (in_marketo + in_stripe + in_zendesk); if any flag is NULL the sum becomes NULL; expected domain is 0–3 from 0/1 flags. Estimated and adjusted activity (stochastic components) - estimated_monthly_activities: simulated with random() per run based on composite_engagement_score: - >=4.0 → 15 + floor(random()*10) ∈ [15,24] - >=3.0 → 8 + floor(random()*7) ∈ [8,14] - >=2.0 → 3 + floor(random()*5) ∈ [3,7] - >=1.0 → 1 + floor(random()*3) ∈ [1,3] - else → floor(random()*2) ∈ [0,1] - Note: random() yields different results each execution; this column is non-deterministic by design. - seasonally_adjusted_activity: estimated_monthly_activities multiplied by a month factor (Nov/Dec/Jan ×1.2; Jun/Jul/Aug ×0.8; else ×1.0); no rounding. - predicted_next_month_activity: estimated_monthly_activities multiplied by a factor from engagement_velocity category (Accelerating ×1.3; Steady High ×1.1; Steady Medium ×1.0; Declining ×0.7; Slow ×0.4; Stagnant ×0.2); no rounding. Engagement velocity, momentum, maturity (rule-based categories) - engagement_velocity (uses activity recency and composite_engagement_score): - <=7 days and score>=3.0 → Accelerating - <=14 days and score>=2.5 → Steady High - <=30 days and score>=2.0 → Steady Medium - <=60 days → Declining - <=90 days → Slow - else → Stagnant - activity_momentum (uses days_since_last_activity and composite_engagement_score): - <=7 days and score>=3.5 → High Momentum - <=14 days and score>=3.0 → Medium Momentum - <=30 days and score>=2.0 → Low Momentum - <=60 days → Losing Momentum - else → No Momentum - engagement_maturity (uses account_age_days and active_channel_count): - age>=365 and channels>=3 → Mature Multi-channel - age>=180 and channels>=2 → Developing Multi-channel - age>=90 and channels>=1 → Single Channel Engaged - age<90 → Early Stage - else → Minimal Engagement Channel scores and depths - marketing_engagement_score: if in_marketo=1 and is_unsubscribed=false and is_email_invalid=false then round(marketo_engagement × (1 − days since last Marketo update / 90), 2); else 0; may be negative; if the last update timestamp is NULL the result is NULL in the true branch. - sales_engagement_score: if in_stripe=1 and is_deleted=false and is_delinquent=false then round(stripe_engagement × (1 − days since last Stripe update / 60), 2); else 0; may be negative; NULL if the last update timestamp is NULL in the true branch. - support_engagement_score: if in_zendesk=1 and is_active=true and is_suspended=false and is_deleted=false then round(zendesk_engagement × (1 − days since last Zendesk update / 120), 2); else 0; may be negative; NULL if the last update timestamp is NULL in the true branch. - primary_engagement_channel: choose the channel with the highest raw engagement; ties break in order Marketing Driven > Sales Driven > Support Driven; if comparisons do not resolve (e.g., NULL inputs) fallback is Balanced. - marketing_depth/sales_depth/support_depth (per channel): if in_* = 1: engagement>=4 → Deep; engagement>=2 → Medium; else → Shallow; if in_*=0 → None. Cross-platform and composite scores - cross_platform_consistency: round( average of raw engagement across platforms where in_*=1, 2 decimals ); returns NULL if no active platforms or if any included operand (flags or raw engagements) is NULL. - activity_efficiency: round(composite_engagement_score divided by active_channel_count, 2); NULL if active_channel_count is 0 or NULL. - weighted_engagement_score: round(0.3×marketing_engagement_score (NULL→0) + 0.5×sales_engagement_score (NULL→0) + 0.2×support_engagement_score (NULL→0), 2); can be negative. - activity_grade: from weighted_engagement_score and active_channel_count: >=4.0 & channels>=3 → A+; >=3.5 & channels>=2 → A; >=3.0 → B+; >=2.5 → B; >=2.0 → C+; >=1.5 → C; >=1.0 → D; else → F. - activity_priority_score: round(0.4×weighted_engagement_score + 0.3×active_channel_count + 0.3×priority_component, 2) where priority_component is 5/4/3/2/1 by recency+composite rules (<=7 days & score>=3.5 → 5; <=14 & score>=3.0 → 4; <=30 & score>=2.0 → 3; <=60 → 2; else → 1). Risk and interventions - activity_risk_level: if days_since_last_activity>90 and customer_health_score<3.0 → High Activity Risk; else if days_since_last_activity>60 or active_channel_count=1 → Medium Activity Risk; else if days_since_last_activity>30 → Low Activity Risk; else → No Activity Risk. - recommended_activity_intervention (evaluated top-to-bottom): Declining/Slow/Stagnant with health>=3.0 → Re-engagement Campaign; else single channel (count=1) with composite>=2.5 → Channel Expansion; else Marketing Driven with in_stripe=0 → Sales Conversion Focus; else Sales Driven with in_zendesk=0 → Success Onboarding; else recent (<=7 days) with composite>=3.5 → Upsell Opportunity; else Standard Engagement.

agent_sql.raw_text:
with base as (
 select *,case when estimated_customer_value>=5000 then 5 when estimated_customer_value>=3000 then 4 when estimated_customer_value>=1500 then 3 when estimated_customer_value>=800 then 2 else 1 end as monetary_score
 from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
), rfm as (
 select *,concat(recency_score::varchar,frequency_score::varchar,monetary_score::varchar) as rfm_score,
 round((recency_score+frequency_score+monetary_score)/3.0,2) as rfm_avg_score,
 estimated_customer_ltv*case lifecycle_stage when 'Acquisition' then .3 when 'Activation' then .6 when 'Growth' then 1.2 when 'Maturity' then 1.0 when 'Retention' then .8 else .5 end as adjusted_ltv,
 case when estimated_customer_ltv>=10000 then 'Tier 1 - Strategic' when estimated_customer_ltv>=5000 then 'Tier 2 - High Value' when estimated_customer_ltv>=2500 then 'Tier 3 - Core' when estimated_customer_ltv>=1000 then 'Tier 4 - Developing' else 'Tier 5 - Basic' end as revenue_tier,
 case when customer_health_score>=4 and churn_probability<=.2 then 'High Stability' when customer_health_score>=3 and churn_probability<=.4 then 'Medium Stability' when customer_health_score>=2 and churn_probability<=.6 then 'Low Stability' else 'Unstable' end as value_stability,
 case when recency_score>=4 and frequency_score>=4 then 'High Upsell' when rfm_avg_score>=3.5 and monetary_score>=3 then 'Medium Upsell' when recency_score>=4 and frequency_score<=2 then 'Cross-sell Focus' else 'Retention Focus' end as upsell_potential
 from base
), scored as (
 select *, round(adjusted_ltv*churn_probability,2) as potential_revenue_loss,
 round(adjusted_ltv*(1-churn_probability)/case when account_age_days>=365 then account_age_days/365.0 else 1 end,2) as expected_annual_revenue,
 case when adjusted_ltv>=50000 then 'High Concentration Risk' when adjusted_ltv>=20000 then 'Medium Concentration Risk' else 'Low Concentration Risk' end as concentration_risk,
 case when churn_probability>=.7 then 5 when churn_probability>=.5 then 4 when churn_probability>=.3 then 3 when churn_probability>=.1 then 2 else 1 end as churn_weight,
 case when rfm_avg_score>=4.5 then 'Champions' when rfm_avg_score>=4 and recency_score>=4 then 'Loyal Customers'
 when rfm_avg_score>=3.5 and monetary_score>=4 then 'Potential Loyalists' when recency_score>=4 and frequency_score<=2 then 'New Customers'
 when recency_score>=3 and frequency_score<=2 and monetary_score<=2 then 'Promising' when recency_score>=3 and monetary_score>=3 then 'Customers Needing Attention'
 when recency_score<=2 and frequency_score>=3 then 'At Risk' when recency_score<=2 and frequency_score<=2 and monetary_score>=4 then 'Cannot Lose Them'
 when recency_score<=1 and frequency_score>=2 then 'Hibernating' else 'Lost' end as rfm_segment
 from rfm
), investment as (
 select *, round((case rfm_segment when 'Champions' then 5 when 'Loyal Customers' then 4.5 when 'Potential Loyalists' then 4 when 'New Customers' then 3.5 when 'Promising' then 3 when 'Customers Needing Attention' then 4.5 when 'At Risk' then 5 when 'Cannot Lose Them' then 5 when 'Hibernating' then 2 else 1 end*.4 +
 case revenue_tier when 'Tier 1 - Strategic' then 5 when 'Tier 2 - High Value' then 4 when 'Tier 3 - Core' then 3 when 'Tier 4 - Developing' then 2 else 1 end*.3+churn_weight*.3),2) as investment_priority_score,
 case when (rfm_segment in ('Champions','Cannot Lose Them') and revenue_tier in ('Tier 1 - Strategic','Tier 2 - High Value')) then 'Strategic Account'
 when rfm_segment in ('Loyal Customers','Potential Loyalists') and revenue_tier in ('Tier 2 - High Value','Tier 3 - Core') then 'Key Account'
 when rfm_segment in ('New Customers','Promising') and revenue_tier in ('Tier 3 - Core','Tier 4 - Developing') then 'Growth Account'
 when rfm_segment in ('At Risk','Hibernating') and revenue_tier in ('Tier 1 - Strategic','Tier 2 - High Value') then 'Recovery Account' else 'Standard Account' end as strategic_classification
 from scored
), portfolio as (
 select *,sum(adjusted_ltv) over() as portfolio_ltv from investment
)
select marketo_lead_id,stripe_customer_id,zendesk_user_id,primary_email,primary_organization,customer_segment,customer_tier,
 rfm_segment,rfm_score,rfm_avg_score,recency_score,frequency_score,monetary_score,estimated_customer_ltv,adjusted_ltv,expected_annual_revenue,revenue_tier,strategic_classification,
 value_stability,upsell_potential,churn_probability,potential_revenue_loss,
 case when adjusted_ltv is null or adjusted_ltv=0 then null else round(churn_probability*100,2) end as revenue_risk_percentage,
 case when portfolio_ltv=0 then null else round(adjusted_ltv/portfolio_ltv*100,4) end as portfolio_contribution_pct,concentration_risk,
 investment_priority_score,
 case when expected_annual_revenue>=5000 then 'Excellent ROI' when expected_annual_revenue>=2000 then 'Good ROI' when expected_annual_revenue>=1000 then 'Acceptable ROI' when expected_annual_revenue>=500 then 'Marginal ROI' else 'Poor ROI' end as acquisition_roi_assessment,
 case strategic_classification when 'Strategic Account' then 'Executive Relationship Management' when 'Key Account' then 'Dedicated Account Management' when 'Growth Account' then 'Expansion Programs' when 'Recovery Account' then 'Retention & Recovery Initiatives' else 'Standard Engagement' end as recommended_engagement_model,
 case when investment_priority_score>=4.5 then 'High Investment' when investment_priority_score>=3.5 then 'Medium Investment' when investment_priority_score>=2.5 then 'Standard Investment' else 'Minimal Investment' end as investment_recommendation,
 case when rfm_segment in ('Champions','Loyal Customers') then 'Maintain Excellence' when rfm_segment in ('Potential Loyalists','Customers Needing Attention') then 'Drive Engagement' when rfm_segment in ('New Customers','Promising') then 'Accelerate Onboarding' when rfm_segment in ('At Risk','Cannot Lose Them') then 'Immediate Intervention' else 'Reactivation Required' end as success_target,
 case when upsell_potential='High Upsell' and value_stability='High Stability' then 'Premium Growth' when upsell_potential in ('High Upsell','Medium Upsell') then 'Expansion Ready' when upsell_potential='Cross-sell Focus' then 'Product Adoption' else 'Value Preservation' end as development_opportunity,
 customer_health_score,lifecycle_stage,
 case when churn_probability>=.7 then 'High Risk' when churn_probability>=.5 then 'Medium Risk' when churn_probability>=.3 then 'Low Risk' else 'Minimal Risk' end as risk_category,
 account_age_days,days_since_last_activity,current_timestamp as analysis_timestamp
from portfolio where primary_email is not null

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__customer_value_analysis
      description: Customer value analysis with RFM, adjusted LTV, portfolio metrics, risk and engagement recommendations
      grain: One row per customer (from int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics) with non-null primary_email
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      business_logic: 'Starting from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (aliased lm), compute RFM metrics and value segments, then portfolio and recommendation metrics; finally filter to rows where primary_email is not NULL and sort for presentation (sorting does not affect metric values). - Monetary score: bucket lm.estimated_customer_value into {>=5000→5, >=3000→4, >=1500→3, >=800→2, else 1}. - RFM score string: concatenate recency_score, frequency_score, and monetary_score with no delimiter in R-F-M order; if any component is NULL the result is NULL. - RFM average: average of recency_score, frequency_score, and monetary_score, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if any component is NULL. - RFM segment: apply deterministic rules in this order: rfm_avg_score≥4.5→Champions; rfm_avg_score≥4.0 and recency_score≥4→Loyal Customers; rfm_avg_score≥3.5 and monetary_score≥4→Potential Loyalists; recency_score≥4 and frequency_score≤2→New Customers; recency_score≥3 and frequency_score≤2 and monetary_score≤2→Promising; recency_score≥3 and monetary_score≥3→Customers Needing Attention; recency_score≤2 and frequency_score≥3→At Risk; recency_score≤2 and frequency_score≤2 and monetary_score≥4→Cannot Lose Them; recency_score≤1 and frequency_score≥2→Hibernating; else Lost. - Adjusted LTV: estimated_customer_ltv multiplied by lifecycle_stage multiplier {Acquisition 0.3, Activation 0.6, Growth 1.2, Maturity 1.0, Retention 0.8, else 0.5}; not explicitly rounded; stored with 3-decimal precision. - Revenue tier: by estimated_customer_ltv thresholds {≥10000 Tier 1 - Strategic; ≥5000 Tier 2 - High Value; ≥2500 Tier 3 - Core; ≥1000 Tier 4 - Developing; else Tier 5 - Basic}. - Value stability: by customer_health_score and churn_probability {≥4.0 and ≤0.20→High Stability; ≥3.0 and ≤0.40→Medium Stability; ≥2.0 and ≤0.60→Low Stability; else Unstable}. - Upsell potential: {rfm_avg_score≥4.0 and frequency_score≥4→High Upsell; rfm_avg_score≥3.5 and monetary_score≥3→Medium Upsell; recency_score≥4 and frequency_score≤2→Cross-sell Focus; else Retention Focus}. - Expected annual revenue: compute adjusted_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) divided by the age denominator (account_age_days/365.0 when account_age_days≥365, otherwise 1); round to 2 decimals; returns NULL if adjusted_ltv or churn_probability is NULL. - Portfolio contribution pct: adjusted_ltv divided by the total adjusted_ltv across all customers in the portfolio (computed before the final email filter), multiplied by 100 and rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when the portfolio total is 0 or NULL. - Concentration risk: by adjusted_ltv {≥50000→High Concentration Risk; ≥20000→Medium Concentration Risk; else Low Concentration Risk}. - Investment priority score: weighted composite of rfm_segment (40%), revenue_tier (30%), and churn risk (30%), rounded to 2 decimals; segment weights {Champions 5; Loyal Customers 4.5; Potential Loyalists 4; New Customers 3.5; Promising 3; Customers Needing Attention 4.5; At Risk 5; Cannot Lose Them 5; Hibernating 2; else 1}; revenue tier weights {Tier 1 - Strategic 5; Tier 2 - High Value 4; Tier 3 - Core 3; Tier 4 - Developing 2; else 1}; churn risk weights by churn_probability {≥0.70→5; ≥0.50→4; ≥0.30→3; ≥0.10→2; else 1}. - Acquisition ROI assessment: by expected_annual_revenue {≥5000→Excellent ROI; ≥2000→Good ROI; ≥1000→Acceptable ROI; ≥500→Marginal ROI; else→Poor ROI}. - Strategic classification: combine rfm_segment and revenue_tier: {(Champions, Cannot Lose Them)∧(Tier 1, Tier 2)→Strategic Account; (Loyal Customers, Potential Loyalists)∧(Tier 2, Tier 3)→Key Account; (New Customers, Promising)∧(Tier 3, Tier 4)→Growth Account; (At Risk, Hibernating)∧(Tier 1, Tier 2)→Recovery Account; else→Standard Account}. - Recommended engagement model: map strategic_classification {Strategic→Executive Relationship Management; Key→Dedicated Account Management; Growth→Expansion Programs; Recovery→Retention & Recovery Initiatives; else→Standard Engagement}. - Investment recommendation: by investment_priority_score {≥4.5→High Investment; ≥3.5→Medium Investment; ≥2.5→Standard Investment; else→Minimal Investment}. - Success target: by rfm_segment {Champions/Loyal Customers→Maintain Excellence; Potential Loyalists/Customers Needing Attention→Drive Engagement; New Customers/Promising→Accelerate Onboarding; At Risk/Cannot Lose Them→Immediate Intervention; else→Reactivation Required}. - Revenue risk percentage: churn_probability expressed as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if adjusted_ltv is NULL or zero. - Development opportunity: by upsell_potential and value_stability {High Upsell∧High Stability→Premium Growth; High/Medium Upsell→Expansion Ready; Cross-sell Focus→Product Adoption; else→Value Preservation}. - Analysis timestamp: set at query execution time (time zone preserved). - Final filter and ordering: keep only rows with primary_email IS NOT NULL; order by investment_priority_score desc, adjusted_ltv desc, customer_health_score desc.'
      columns:
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead identifier from lifecycle metrics; may be NULL if not available
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer identifier from lifecycle metrics; opaque string; may be NULL
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user identifier from lifecycle metrics; may be NULL
      - name: primary_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary customer email; final result filters to non-NULL values
      - name: primary_organization
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer organization name from lifecycle metrics; free text; may be NULL
      - name: customer_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream segment label from lifecycle metrics; not recomputed here
      - name: customer_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Upstream customer tier from lifecycle metrics; not recomputed here
      - name: rfm_segment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic RFM segment per case rules using rfm_avg_score, recency_score, frequency_score, and monetary_score
      - name: rfm_score
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Three-digit string formed by concatenating recency, frequency, and monetary scores in R-F-M order with no delimiter; NULL if any component is NULL
      - name: rfm_avg_score
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of recency_score, frequency_score, and monetary_score rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if any component is NULL
      - name: recency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Recency score from lifecycle metrics (expected 1–5); higher is more recent; may be NULL
      - name: frequency_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Frequency score from lifecycle metrics (expected 1–5); higher is more frequent; may be NULL
      - name: monetary_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Derived spend score (1–5) bucketed from estimated_customer_value using thresholds: >=5000, >=3000, >=1500, >=800, else 1'
      - name: estimated_customer_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Upstream estimated customer lifetime value in source currency with 2-decimal precision; may be NULL
      - name: adjusted_ltv
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,3)
        description: 'Lifecycle-stage-adjusted LTV (multipliers: Acquisition 0.3, Activation 0.6, Growth 1.2, Maturity 1.0, Retention 0.8, else 0.5) stored with 3-decimal precision; not explicitly rounded in SQL'
      - name: expected_annual_revenue
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Adjusted LTV × (1 − churn_probability) divided by account_age_days/365.0 when age≥365, otherwise by 1; rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if adjusted_ltv or churn_probability is NULL
      - name: revenue_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier based on estimated_customer_ltv: >=10000 Tier 1 - Strategic; >=5000 Tier 2 - High Value; >=2500 Tier 3 - Core; >=1000 Tier 4 - Developing; else Tier 5 - Basic'
      - name: strategic_classification
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Account class from rfm_segment and revenue_tier: Strategic, Key, Growth, Recovery, or Standard per deterministic mapping'
      - name: value_stability
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stability category by customer_health_score and churn_probability: High, Medium, Low, or Unstable per thresholds'
      - name: upsell_potential
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Opportunity label from RFM metrics: High Upsell, Medium Upsell, Cross-sell Focus, or Retention Focus'
      - name: churn_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Probability of churn in [0.00,1.00] from lifecycle metrics; used directly in downstream formulas
      - name: potential_revenue_loss
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,2)
        description: Product of adjusted LTV and churn_probability rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if either input is NULL
      - name: revenue_risk_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Churn probability expressed as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if adjusted_ltv is NULL or zero
      - name: portfolio_contribution_pct
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Adjusted LTV as a percentage of total adjusted LTV across all customers (before email filter), rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when the portfolio total is 0 or NULL
      - name: concentration_risk
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk bucket by adjusted_ltv: >=50000 High, >=20000 Medium, else Low Concentration Risk'
      - name: investment_priority_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Weighted composite of segment (40%), revenue tier (30%), and churn risk (30%), rounded to 2 decimals
      - name: acquisition_roi_assessment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'ROI category by expected_annual_revenue: Excellent, Good, Acceptable, Marginal, or Poor ROI'
      - name: recommended_engagement_model
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Engagement model derived from strategic_classification: Executive, Dedicated AM, Expansion Programs, Retention & Recovery, or Standard'
      - name: investment_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Allocation suggestion by investment_priority_score: High, Medium, Standard, or Minimal Investment'
      - name: success_target
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Customer success focus by rfm_segment: Maintain Excellence, Drive Engagement, Accelerate Onboarding, Immediate Intervention, or Reactivation Required'
      - name: development_opportunity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Opportunity theme by upsell_potential and value_stability: Premium Growth, Expansion Ready, Product Adoption, or Value Preservation'
      - name: customer_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(15,2)
        description: Upstream health score (higher is better) used in stability scoring; 2-decimal precision
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Customer lifecycle stage from lifecycle metrics (e.g., Acquisition, Activation, Growth, Maturity, Retention)
