specification.name: customer360__customer_value_analysis
specification.description: Customer value analysis with RFM, adjusted LTV, portfolio metrics, risk and engagement recommendations
specification.grain: One row per customer (from int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics) with non-null primary_email
specification.business_logic: Starting from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics (aliased lm), compute RFM metrics and value segments, then portfolio and recommendation metrics; finally filter to rows where primary_email is not NULL and sort for presentation (sorting does not affect metric values). - Monetary score: bucket lm.estimated_customer_value into {>=5000→5, >=3000→4, >=1500→3, >=800→2, else 1}. - RFM score string: concatenate recency_score, frequency_score, and monetary_score with no delimiter in R-F-M order; if any component is NULL the result is NULL. - RFM average: average of recency_score, frequency_score, and monetary_score, rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if any component is NULL. - RFM segment: apply deterministic rules in this order: rfm_avg_score≥4.5→Champions; rfm_avg_score≥4.0 and recency_score≥4→Loyal Customers; rfm_avg_score≥3.5 and monetary_score≥4→Potential Loyalists; recency_score≥4 and frequency_score≤2→New Customers; recency_score≥3 and frequency_score≤2 and monetary_score≤2→Promising; recency_score≥3 and monetary_score≥3→Customers Needing Attention; recency_score≤2 and frequency_score≥3→At Risk; recency_score≤2 and frequency_score≤2 and monetary_score≥4→Cannot Lose Them; recency_score≤1 and frequency_score≥2→Hibernating; else Lost. - Adjusted LTV: estimated_customer_ltv multiplied by lifecycle_stage multiplier {Acquisition 0.3, Activation 0.6, Growth 1.2, Maturity 1.0, Retention 0.8, else 0.5}; not explicitly rounded; stored with 3-decimal precision. - Revenue tier: by estimated_customer_ltv thresholds {≥10000 Tier 1 - Strategic; ≥5000 Tier 2 - High Value; ≥2500 Tier 3 - Core; ≥1000 Tier 4 - Developing; else Tier 5 - Basic}. - Value stability: by customer_health_score and churn_probability {≥4.0 and ≤0.20→High Stability; ≥3.0 and ≤0.40→Medium Stability; ≥2.0 and ≤0.60→Low Stability; else Unstable}. - Upsell potential: {rfm_avg_score≥4.0 and frequency_score≥4→High Upsell; rfm_avg_score≥3.5 and monetary_score≥3→Medium Upsell; recency_score≥4 and frequency_score≤2→Cross-sell Focus; else Retention Focus}. - Expected annual revenue: compute adjusted_ltv × (1 − churn_probability) divided by the age denominator (account_age_days/365.0 when account_age_days≥365, otherwise 1); round to 2 decimals; returns NULL if adjusted_ltv or churn_probability is NULL. - Portfolio contribution pct: adjusted_ltv divided by the total adjusted_ltv across all customers in the portfolio (computed before the final email filter), multiplied by 100 and rounded to 4 decimals; NULL when the portfolio total is 0 or NULL. - Concentration risk: by adjusted_ltv {≥50000→High Concentration Risk; ≥20000→Medium Concentration Risk; else Low Concentration Risk}. - Investment priority score: weighted composite of rfm_segment (40%), revenue_tier (30%), and churn risk (30%), rounded to 2 decimals; segment weights {Champions 5; Loyal Customers 4.5; Potential Loyalists 4; New Customers 3.5; Promising 3; Customers Needing Attention 4.5; At Risk 5; Cannot Lose Them 5; Hibernating 2; else 1}; revenue tier weights {Tier 1 - Strategic 5; Tier 2 - High Value 4; Tier 3 - Core 3; Tier 4 - Developing 2; else 1}; churn risk weights by churn_probability {≥0.70→5; ≥0.50→4; ≥0.30→3; ≥0.10→2; else 1}. - Acquisition ROI assessment: by expected_annual_revenue {≥5000→Excellent ROI; ≥2000→Good ROI; ≥1000→Acceptable ROI; ≥500→Marginal ROI; else→Poor ROI}. - Strategic classification: combine rfm_segment and revenue_tier: {(Champions, Cannot Lose Them)∧(Tier 1, Tier 2)→Strategic Account; (Loyal Customers, Potential Loyalists)∧(Tier 2, Tier 3)→Key Account; (New Customers, Promising)∧(Tier 3, Tier 4)→Growth Account; (At Risk, Hibernating)∧(Tier 1, Tier 2)→Recovery Account; else→Standard Account}. - Recommended engagement model: map strategic_classification {Strategic→Executive Relationship Management; Key→Dedicated Account Management; Growth→Expansion Programs; Recovery→Retention & Recovery Initiatives; else→Standard Engagement}. - Investment recommendation: by investment_priority_score {≥4.5→High Investment; ≥3.5→Medium Investment; ≥2.5→Standard Investment; else→Minimal Investment}. - Success target: by rfm_segment {Champions/Loyal Customers→Maintain Excellence; Potential Loyalists/Customers Needing Attention→Drive Engagement; New Customers/Promising→Accelerate Onboarding; At Risk/Cannot Lose Them→Immediate Intervention; else→Reactivation Required}. - Revenue risk percentage: churn_probability expressed as a percentage rounded to 2 decimals; NULL if adjusted_ltv is NULL or zero. - Development opportunity: by upsell_potential and value_stability {High Upsell∧High Stability→Premium Growth; High/Medium Upsell→Expansion Ready; Cross-sell Focus→Product Adoption; else→Value Preservation}. - Analysis timestamp: set at query execution time (time zone preserved). - Final filter and ordering: keep only rows with primary_email IS NOT NULL; order by investment_priority_score desc, adjusted_ltv desc, customer_health_score desc.

with source_rows as (
 select sm.marketo_lead_id, sm.stripe_customer_id, sm.zendesk_user_id,
        m.organization_name_no_suffix as m_org, m.inferred_organization_name_no_suffix as mi_org,
        s.customer_organization_name_no_suffix as s_org, s.shipping_organization_name_no_suffix as ss_org,
        z.organization_id, sm.marketo_updated_at, sm.marketo_created_at, sm.stripe_updated_at, sm.stripe_created_at,
        sm.zendesk_updated_at, sm.zendesk_organization_updated_at, sm.zendesk_created_at, sm.zendesk_organization_created_at
 from intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches sm
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo m on sm.marketo_lead_id=m.lead_id
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on sm.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk z on sm.zendesk_user_id=z.user_id
 union all
 select m.lead_id,null::varchar,null::bigint,m.organization_name_no_suffix,m.inferred_organization_name_no_suffix,null,null,null,m.updated_at,m.created_at,null,null,null,null,null,null
 from intermediate.int_customer360__marketo m where not exists (select 1 from intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches sm where sm.marketo_lead_id=m.lead_id)
 union all
 select null,s.customer_id,null,null,null,s.customer_organization_name_no_suffix,s.shipping_organization_name_no_suffix,null,s.updated_at,s.created_at,s.updated_at,s.created_at,null,null,null,null
 from intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s where not exists (select 1 from intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches sm where sm.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id)
 union all
 select null,null,z.user_id,null,null,null,null,z.organization_id,z.updated_at,z.created_at,null,null,z.updated_at,z.organization_updated_at,z.created_at,z.organization_created_at
 from intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk z where not exists (select 1 from intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches sm where sm.zendesk_user_id=z.user_id)
), organization_keys as (
 select *, md5(coalesce(m_org,'')||'|'||coalesce(mi_org,'')||'|'||coalesce(s_org,'')||'|'||coalesce(ss_org,'')||'|'||coalesce(organization_id::varchar,'')) as customer360_organization_id
 from source_rows
), individuals as (
 select md5(coalesce(marketo_lead_id::varchar,'')||'|'||coalesce(stripe_customer_id,'')||'|'||coalesce(zendesk_user_id::varchar,'')||'|false|'||customer360_organization_id) as customer360_id,
 customer360_organization_id, marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, false as is_organization_header,
 '{"marketo":"'||coalesce(marketo_lead_id::varchar,'')||'","stripe":"'||coalesce(stripe_customer_id,'')||'","zendesk":"'||coalesce(zendesk_user_id::varchar,'')||'"}' as source_ids,
 greatest(marketo_updated_at, stripe_updated_at, zendesk_updated_at) as marketo_updated_at,
 least(marketo_created_at, stripe_created_at, zendesk_created_at) as marketo_created_at,
 stripe_updated_at, stripe_created_at, zendesk_updated_at, zendesk_organization_updated_at,zendesk_created_at,zendesk_organization_created_at
 from organization_keys
), headers as (
 select md5('|||'||'true|'||customer360_organization_id) as customer360_id, customer360_organization_id,
 null::bigint as marketo_lead_id,null::varchar as stripe_customer_id,null::bigint as zendesk_user_id,true as is_organization_header,
 '{"marketo":['||coalesce(string_agg(distinct '"'||coalesce(marketo_lead_id::varchar,'')||'"',','),'')||'],"stripe":['||coalesce(string_agg(distinct '"'||coalesce(stripe_customer_id,'')||'"',','),'')||'],"zendesk":['||coalesce(string_agg(distinct '"'||coalesce(zendesk_user_id::varchar,'')||'"',','),'')||']}' as source_ids,
 max(marketo_updated_at) as marketo_updated_at,min(marketo_created_at) as marketo_created_at,max(stripe_updated_at) as stripe_updated_at,min(stripe_created_at) as stripe_created_at,
 max(zendesk_updated_at) as zendesk_updated_at,max(zendesk_organization_updated_at) as zendesk_organization_updated_at,min(zendesk_created_at) as zendesk_created_at,min(zendesk_organization_created_at) as zendesk_organization_created_at
 from organization_keys group by customer360_organization_id
)
select * from individuals union all select * from headers

cte_definitions.name: source_rows
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT sm.marketo_lead_id, sm.stripe_customer_id, sm.zendesk_user_id, m.organization_name_no_suffix AS m_org, m.inferred_organization_name_no_suffix AS mi_org, s.customer_organization_name_no_suffix AS s_org, s.shipping_organization_name_no_suffix AS ss_org, z.organization_id, sm.marketo_updated_at, sm.marketo_created_at, sm.stripe_updated_at, sm.stripe_created_at, sm.zendesk_updated_at, sm.zendesk_organization_updated_at, sm.zendesk_created_at, sm.zendesk_organization_created_at FROM intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches AS sm LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_customer360__marketo AS m ON sm.marketo_lead_id = m.lead_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_customer360__stripe AS s ON sm.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id LEFT JOIN intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk AS z ON sm.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id UNION ALL SELECT m.lead_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT), CAST(NULL AS BIGINT), m.organization_name_no_suffix, m.inferred_organization_name_no_suffix, NULL, NULL, NULL, m.updated_at, m.created_at, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM intermediate.int_customer360__marketo AS m WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches AS sm WHERE sm.marketo_lead_id = m.lead_id) UNION ALL SELECT NULL, s.customer_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, s.customer_organization_name_no_suffix, s.shipping_organization_name_no_suffix, NULL, s.updated_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at, s.created_at, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM intermediate.int_customer360__stripe AS s WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches AS sm WHERE sm.stripe_customer_id = s.customer_id) UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, z.user_id, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, z.organization_id, z.updated_at, z.created_at, NULL, NULL, z.updated_at, z.organization_updated_at, z.created_at, z.organization_created_at FROM intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk AS z WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches AS sm WHERE sm.zendesk_user_id = z.user_id)

cte_definitions.name: organization_keys
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT *, MD5(COALESCE(m_org, '') || '|' || COALESCE(mi_org, '') || '|' || COALESCE(s_org, '') || '|' || COALESCE(ss_org, '') || '|' || COALESCE(CAST(organization_id AS TEXT), '')) AS customer360_organization_id FROM source_rows

cte_definitions.name: individuals
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT MD5(COALESCE(CAST(marketo_lead_id AS TEXT), '') || '|' || COALESCE(stripe_customer_id, '') || '|' || COALESCE(CAST(zendesk_user_id AS TEXT), '') || '|false|' || customer360_organization_id) AS customer360_id, customer360_organization_id, marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, FALSE AS is_organization_header, '{"marketo":"' || COALESCE(CAST(marketo_lead_id AS TEXT), '') || '","stripe":"' || COALESCE(stripe_customer_id, '') || '","zendesk":"' || COALESCE(CAST(zendesk_user_id AS TEXT), '') || '"}' AS source_ids, GREATEST(marketo_updated_at, stripe_updated_at, zendesk_updated_at) AS marketo_updated_at, LEAST(marketo_created_at, stripe_created_at, zendesk_created_at) AS marketo_created_at, stripe_updated_at, stripe_created_at, zendesk_updated_at, zendesk_organization_updated_at, zendesk_created_at, zendesk_organization_created_at FROM organization_keys

cte_definitions.name: headers
cte_definitions.sql: SELECT MD5('|||' || 'true|' || customer360_organization_id) AS customer360_id, customer360_organization_id, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS marketo_lead_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stripe_customer_id, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS zendesk_user_id, TRUE AS is_organization_header, '{"marketo":[' || COALESCE(LISTAGG(DISTINCT '"' || COALESCE(CAST(marketo_lead_id AS TEXT), '') || '"', ','), '') || '],"stripe":[' || COALESCE(LISTAGG(DISTINCT '"' || COALESCE(stripe_customer_id, '') || '"', ','), '') || '],"zendesk":[' || COALESCE(LISTAGG(DISTINCT '"' || COALESCE(CAST(zendesk_user_id AS TEXT), '') || '"', ','), '') || ']}' AS source_ids, MAX(marketo_updated_at) AS marketo_updated_at, MIN(marketo_created_at) AS marketo_created_at, MAX(stripe_updated_at) AS stripe_updated_at, MIN(stripe_created_at) AS stripe_created_at, MAX(zendesk_updated_at) AS zendesk_updated_at, MAX(zendesk_organization_updated_at) AS zendesk_organization_updated_at, MIN(zendesk_created_at) AS zendesk_created_at, MIN(zendesk_organization_created_at) AS zendesk_organization_created_at FROM organization_keys GROUP BY customer360_organization_id

blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__mapping
      description: Customer identity mapping linking unified and organizational hashes to source system records and an organization-level header row with aggregated metadata
      grain: 'Mixed: individual rows per combined source record (is_organization_header=false) and one header row per customer360_organization_id (is_organization_header=true)'
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__source_matches
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: '1) Load four inputs: source_matches, marketo, stripe, zendesk. 2) Build combine_all_results: - Chain full outer joins: source_matches to marketo on lead_id, then to stripe on customer_id from source_matches, then to zendesk on user_id from source_matches, retaining all records from every source. - For IDs, prefer the value from source_matches when present; otherwise use the corresponding source table value. - Per-row timestamps: - marketo_updated_at = the most recent non-null updated_at among marketo/stripe/zendesk for that row, taking source_matches timestamps when available, else the source table’s. - marketo_created_at = the earliest non-null created_at among marketo/stripe/zendesk for that row, taking source_matches timestamps when available, else the source table’s. - stripe_updated_at / stripe_created_at = the stripe timestamp from source_matches when present, otherwise from stripe. - zendesk_updated_at / zendesk_created_at = the zendesk timestamp from source_matches when present, otherwise from zendesk. - zendesk_organization_* = the zendesk organization timestamps from source_matches when present, otherwise from zendesk.organization_*. - Union in three additional sets to also include any marketo/stripe/zendesk records whose IDs are not present in source_matches; these rows carry only their own system fields, others null. This can yield duplicates relative to the full outer joins. 3) For each row, derive customer360_organization_id by hashing the pipe-joined values (marketo org name without suffix, marketo inferred org name without suffix, stripe customer org name without suffix, stripe shipping org name without suffix, zendesk organization_id), treating nulls as empty strings. 4) Emit two row types: - Individual rows (is_organization_header=false): include the three source IDs; source_ids is a compact JSON-like object {"marketo":"...","stripe":"...","zendesk":"..."} where null IDs are rendered as empty strings; timestamps are the per-row values from step 2. - One organization header row per customer360_organization_id (is_organization_header=true): source IDs are null; source_ids is a JSON-like object with arrays per system containing distinct quoted IDs for that organization (comma-delimited, no spaces), with nulls rendered as empty strings; timestamps aggregated per organization as latest updated_at and earliest created_at for each system; zendesk organization timestamps use latest for updated and earliest for created. 5) Assign customer360_id by hashing the pipe-joined values (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id, is_organization_header, customer360_organization_id), treating nulls as empty strings and using the engine’s string form of the boolean.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic 32-character hex md5 of marketo_lead_id|stripe_customer_id|zendesk_user_id|is_organization_header|customer360_organization_id with nulls as empty strings and the engine’s string form of the boolean.
      - name: customer360_organization_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Deterministic 32-character hex md5 of marketo_org_name_no_suffix|marketo_inferred_org_name_no_suffix|stripe_customer_org_name_no_suffix|stripe_shipping_org_name_no_suffix|zendesk_organization_id with nulls as empty strings.
      - name: marketo_lead_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Marketo lead ID; on individual rows prefer source_matches, else marketo; null on organization header rows.
      - name: stripe_customer_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Stripe customer ID; on individual rows prefer source_matches, else stripe; null on organization header rows.
      - name: zendesk_user_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Zendesk user ID; on individual rows prefer source_matches, else zendesk; null on organization header rows.
      - name: is_organization_header
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: 'Row type flag: false for individual rows; true for the single aggregated header row per customer360_organization_id.'
      - name: source_ids
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'JSON-like string; individual rows: {"marketo":"...","stripe":"...","zendesk":"..."} with nulls as empty strings; header rows: arrays per system of distinct quoted IDs joined by commas (no spaces), nulls as empty strings, order not enforced.'
      - name: marketo_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Individual rows: latest non-null updated_at across marketo, stripe, and zendesk after preferring source_matches timestamps; header rows: latest marketo_updated_at in the organization; null if none.'
      - name: marketo_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Individual rows: earliest non-null created_at across marketo, stripe, and zendesk after preferring source_matches timestamps; header rows: earliest marketo_created_at in the organization; null if none.'
      - name: stripe_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Individual rows: stripe updated_at from source_matches when available, otherwise from stripe; header rows: latest stripe_updated_at in the organization; null if none.'
      - name: stripe_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Individual rows: stripe created_at from source_matches when available, otherwise from stripe; header rows: earliest stripe_created_at in the organization; null if none.'
      - name: zendesk_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Individual rows: zendesk updated_at from source_matches when available, otherwise from zendesk; header rows: latest zendesk_updated_at in the organization; null if none.'
      - name: zendesk_organization_updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Individual rows: zendesk organization_updated_at from source_matches when available, otherwise from zendesk; header rows: latest org updated_at in the organization; null if none.'
      - name: zendesk_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Individual rows: zendesk created_at from source_matches when available, otherwise from zendesk; header rows: earliest zendesk_created_at in the organization; null if none.'
      - name: zendesk_organization_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: 'Individual rows: zendesk organization_created_at from source_matches when available, otherwise from zendesk; header rows: earliest org created_at in the organization; null if none.'

agent_sql.raw_text:
with entities as (
 select ba.primary_email,ba.marketo_lead_id,ba.stripe_customer_id,ba.zendesk_user_id,ba.primary_organization,ba.customer_journey_pattern,ba.customer_segment,ba.composite_engagement_score,
 lm.customer_health_score,lm.estimated_customer_ltv,lm.customer_tier,lm.lifecycle_stage,
 va.adjusted_ltv,va.strategic_classification,va.revenue_tier,
 case when ba.primary_organization is null or trim(ba.primary_organization)='' then 'INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER' else upper(trim(ba.primary_organization)) end as standardized_org_name,
 coalesce(nullif(split_part(ba.primary_email,'@',2),''),'unknown.domain') as email_domain
 from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis ba
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics lm using(primary_email)
 left join marts.customer360__customer_value_analysis va using(primary_email)
), classified as (
 select *,case when primary_organization is null or trim(primary_organization)='' then 'Individual'
 when regexp_matches(lower(primary_organization),'inc|corp|llc|ltd') then 'Corporation'
 when regexp_matches(lower(primary_organization),'university|college|school') then 'Education'
 when regexp_matches(lower(primary_organization),'government|dept|agency') then 'Government'
 when regexp_matches(lower(primary_organization),'nonprofit|foundation|charity') then 'Non-Profit' else 'Business' end as organization_type,
 case when lower(email_domain) in ('gmail.com','yahoo.com','hotmail.com','outlook.com') then 'Personal'
 when lower(email_domain) in ('microsoft.com','google.com','amazon.com','apple.com','facebook.com') then 'Enterprise'
 when length(primary_organization)>20 then 'Large Business' when length(primary_organization)>10 then 'Medium Business' when length(primary_organization)>0 then 'Small Business' else 'Individual' end as estimated_org_size
 from entities
), aggs as (
 select standardized_org_name,email_domain,organization_type,estimated_org_size,count(distinct primary_email)::bigint as total_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where marketo_lead_id is not null)::bigint as marketing_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where stripe_customer_id is not null)::bigint as sales_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where zendesk_user_id is not null)::bigint as support_contacts,
 count(distinct email_domain)::bigint as email_domains_count,count(distinct customer_tier)::bigint as customer_tiers_represented,
 sum(estimated_customer_ltv) as total_organization_ltv,sum(adjusted_ltv) as total_adjusted_ltv,avg(estimated_customer_ltv) as avg_customer_ltv,max(estimated_customer_ltv) as highest_customer_ltv,
 avg(composite_engagement_score) as avg_engagement_score,max(composite_engagement_score) as max_engagement_score,avg(customer_health_score) as avg_health_score,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where customer_journey_pattern='Full Journey')::bigint as full_journey_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where strategic_classification='Strategic Account')::bigint as strategic_accounts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where strategic_classification='Key Account')::bigint as key_accounts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where strategic_classification='Growth Account')::bigint as growth_accounts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where strategic_classification='Recovery Account')::bigint as recovery_accounts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where customer_segment='Champion')::bigint as champions,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where customer_segment='Loyal Customer')::bigint as loyal_customers,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where customer_segment='At Risk')::bigint as at_risk_customers,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where revenue_tier='Tier 1 - Strategic')::bigint as tier1_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where revenue_tier='Tier 2 - High Value')::bigint as tier2_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where revenue_tier='Tier 3 - Core')::bigint as tier3_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where lifecycle_stage='Growth')::bigint as growth_stage_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where lifecycle_stage='Maturity')::bigint as maturity_stage_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where lifecycle_stage='Dormant')::bigint as dormant_contacts
 from classified group by all
), scored as (
 select *,round((case when total_organization_ltv>=50000 then 5 when total_organization_ltv>=25000 then 4 when total_organization_ltv>=10000 then 3 when total_organization_ltv>=5000 then 2 else 1 end*.4+
 case when total_contacts>=10 then 5 when total_contacts>=5 then 4 when total_contacts>=3 then 3 when total_contacts>=2 then 2 else 1 end*.3+
 case when avg_engagement_score>=4 then 5 when avg_engagement_score>=3 then 4 when avg_engagement_score>=2.5 then 3 when avg_engagement_score>=2 then 2 else 1 end*.3),2)::decimal(14,1) as organization_value_score,
 round(.4*coalesce(avg_health_score,0)+.3*(champions+loyal_customers)::double/nullif(total_contacts,0)*5+.3*(growth_stage_contacts+maturity_stage_contacts)::double/nullif(total_contacts,0)*5,2) as organization_health_score,
 round(5.0*(marketing_contacts+sales_contacts+support_contacts)::double/(3*nullif(total_contacts,0)),2) as account_penetration_score,
 round(100*(.3*marketing_contacts+.4*sales_contacts+.3*support_contacts)::double/nullif(total_contacts,0),2) as engagement_breadth_percentage,
 case when total_contacts>=10 and full_journey_contacts>=3 then 'Mature Enterprise' when total_contacts>=5 and strategic_accounts+key_accounts>=2 then 'Developing Enterprise' when total_contacts>=3 and total_organization_ltv>=10000 then 'Mid-Market' when total_contacts>=2 then 'Small Business' else 'Individual/Micro' end as organization_maturity,
 case when growth_accounts>=2 and avg_engagement_score>=3 then 'High Growth Potential' when growth_accounts>=1 or avg_engagement_score>=3.5 then 'Medium Growth Potential' when total_contacts>=2 and avg_health_score>=3 then 'Stable Growth Potential' else 'Limited Growth Potential' end as growth_potential,
 case when at_risk_customers>=.5*total_contacts then 'High Risk' when dormant_contacts>=.3*total_contacts then 'Medium Risk' when recovery_accounts>=1 then 'Attention Needed' else 'Stable' end as organization_risk_level,
 case when strategic_accounts>=2 or total_organization_ltv>=100000 then 'Strategic Enterprise' when key_accounts>=2 or total_organization_ltv>=50000 then 'Key Enterprise' when total_contacts>=5 or total_organization_ltv>=25000 then 'Important Account' when total_contacts>=2 or total_organization_ltv>=10000 then 'Standard Account' else 'Small Account' end as strategic_value_tier,
 case when total_contacts=1 then 'High Concentration Risk' when total_contacts<=3 then 'Medium Concentration Risk' when email_domains_count=1 and total_contacts>=5 then 'Domain Concentration Risk' else 'Low Concentration Risk' end as concentration_risk
 from aggs
), network as (
 select *,round(100*total_organization_ltv/nullif(sum(total_organization_ltv) over(partition by organization_type),0),4) as market_share_within_type,
 row_number() over(partition by organization_type order by total_organization_ltv desc) as ltv_rank_within_type,
 row_number() over(partition by organization_type order by total_contacts desc) as contacts_rank_within_type,
 row_number() over(partition by organization_type order by organization_value_score desc) as value_score_rank_within_type,
 case when total_contacts>=5 and marketing_contacts=0 then 3 when total_contacts>=3 and sales_contacts=0 then 3 when total_contacts>=2 and support_contacts=0 then 2 else 0 end+
 case growth_potential when 'High Growth Potential' then 2 when 'Medium Growth Potential' then 1 else 0 end+
 case when avg_engagement_score>=3.5 then 2 when avg_engagement_score>=3 then 1 else 0 end as cross_sell_opportunity_score
 from scored
), final as (
 select *,case when strategic_value_tier in ('Strategic Enterprise','Key Enterprise') and growth_potential='High Growth Potential' then 'Immediate Expansion' when organization_value_score>=4 and organization_health_score>=4 then 'High Priority Expansion' when total_contacts>=3 and avg_engagement_score>=3 then 'Medium Priority Expansion' when total_contacts>=2 and organization_risk_level='Stable' then 'Low Priority Expansion' else 'Maintenance Mode' end as expansion_priority,
 case when organization_risk_level='High Risk' then 'Risk Mitigation & Recovery' when strategic_value_tier='Strategic Enterprise' then 'White Glove Account Management' when strategic_value_tier='Key Enterprise' then 'Dedicated Account Management' when growth_potential='High Growth Potential' then 'Growth & Expansion Focus' when total_contacts=1 then 'Relationship Expansion' else 'Standard Account Management' end as recommended_strategy,
 round(.3*organization_value_score+.3*(case when total_contacts>=10 then 5 when total_contacts>=5 then 4 when total_contacts>=3 then 3 when total_contacts>=2 then 2 else 1 end)+
 .2*(case when engagement_breadth_percentage>=80 then 5 when engagement_breadth_percentage>=60 then 4 when engagement_breadth_percentage>=40 then 3 when engagement_breadth_percentage>=20 then 2 else 1 end)+
 .2*(case when market_share_within_type>=10 then 5 when market_share_within_type>=5 then 4 when market_share_within_type>=2 then 3 when market_share_within_type>=1 then 2 else 1 end),2) as organization_influence_score
 from network
)

 from intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis ba
 left join intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics lm using(primary_email)
 left join marts.customer360__customer_value_analysis va using(primary_email)
), classified as (
 select *,case when primary_organization is null or trim(primary_organization)='' then 'Individual'
 when regexp_matches(lower(primary_organization),'inc|corp|llc|ltd') then 'Corporation'
 when regexp_matches(lower(primary_organization),'university|college|school') then 'Education'
 when regexp_matches(lower(primary_organization),'government|dept|agency') then 'Government'
 when regexp_matches(lower(primary_organization),'nonprofit|foundation|charity') then 'Non-Profit' else 'Business' end as organization_type,
 case when lower(email_domain) in ('gmail.com','yahoo.com','hotmail.com','outlook.com') then 'Personal'
 when lower(email_domain) in ('microsoft.com','google.com','amazon.com','apple.com','facebook.com') then 'Enterprise'
 when length(primary_organization)>20 then 'Large Business' when length(primary_organization)>10 then 'Medium Business' when length(primary_organization)>0 then 'Small Business' else 'Individual' end as estimated_org_size
 from entities
), aggs as (
 select standardized_org_name,email_domain,organization_type,estimated_org_size,count(distinct primary_email)::bigint as total_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where marketo_lead_id is not null)::bigint as marketing_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where stripe_customer_id is not null)::bigint as sales_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where zendesk_user_id is not null)::bigint as support_contacts,
 count(distinct email_domain)::bigint as email_domains_count,count(distinct customer_tier)::bigint as customer_tiers_represented,
 sum(estimated_customer_ltv) as total_organization_ltv,sum(adjusted_ltv) as total_adjusted_ltv,avg(estimated_customer_ltv) as avg_customer_ltv,max(estimated_customer_ltv) as highest_customer_ltv,
 avg(composite_engagement_score) as avg_engagement_score,max(composite_engagement_score) as max_engagement_score,avg(customer_health_score) as avg_health_score,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where customer_journey_pattern='Full Journey')::bigint as full_journey_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where strategic_classification='Strategic Account')::bigint as strategic_accounts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where strategic_classification='Key Account')::bigint as key_accounts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where strategic_classification='Growth Account')::bigint as growth_accounts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where strategic_classification='Recovery Account')::bigint as recovery_accounts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where customer_segment='Champion')::bigint as champions,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where customer_segment='Loyal Customer')::bigint as loyal_customers,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where customer_segment='At Risk')::bigint as at_risk_customers,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where revenue_tier='Tier 1 - Strategic')::bigint as tier1_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where revenue_tier='Tier 2 - High Value')::bigint as tier2_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where revenue_tier='Tier 3 - Core')::bigint as tier3_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where lifecycle_stage='Growth')::bigint as growth_stage_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where lifecycle_stage='Maturity')::bigint as maturity_stage_contacts,
 count(distinct primary_email) filter(where lifecycle_stage='Dormant')::bigint as dormant_contacts
 from classified group by all
), scored as (
 select *,round((case when total_organization_ltv>=50000 then 5 when total_organization_ltv>=25000 then 4 when total_organization_ltv>=10000 then 3 when total_organization_ltv>=5000 then 2 else 1 end*.4+
 case when total_contacts>=10 then 5 when total_contacts>=5 then 4 when total_contacts>=3 then 3 when total_contacts>=2 then 2 else 1 end*.3+
 case when avg_engagement_score>=4 then 5 when avg_engagement_score>=3 then 4 when avg_engagement_score>=2.5 then 3 when avg_engagement_score>=2 then 2 else 1 end*.3),2)::decimal(14,1) as organization_value_score,
 round(.4*coalesce(avg_health_score,0)+.3*(champions+loyal_customers)::double/nullif(total_contacts,0)*5+.3*(growth_stage_contacts+maturity_stage_contacts)::double/nullif(total_contacts,0)*5,2) as organization_health_score,
 round(5.0*(marketing_contacts+sales_contacts+support_contacts)::double/(3*nullif(total_contacts,0)),2) as account_penetration_score,
 round(100*(.3*marketing_contacts+.4*sales_contacts+.3*support_contacts)::double/nullif(total_contacts,0),2) as engagement_breadth_percentage,
 case when total_contacts>=10 and full_journey_contacts>=3 then 'Mature Enterprise' when total_contacts>=5 and strategic_accounts+key_accounts>=2 then 'Developing Enterprise' when total_contacts>=3 and total_organization_ltv>=10000 then 'Mid-Market' when total_contacts>=2 then 'Small Business' else 'Individual/Micro' end as organization_maturity,
 case when growth_accounts>=2 and avg_engagement_score>=3 then 'High Growth Potential' when growth_accounts>=1 or avg_engagement_score>=3.5 then 'Medium Growth Potential' when total_contacts>=2 and avg_health_score>=3 then 'Stable Growth Potential' else 'Limited Growth Potential' end as growth_potential,
 case when at_risk_customers>=.5*total_contacts then 'High Risk' when dormant_contacts>=.3*total_contacts then 'Medium Risk' when recovery_accounts>=1 then 'Attention Needed' else 'Stable' end as organization_risk_level,
 case when strategic_accounts>=2 or total_organization_ltv>=100000 then 'Strategic Enterprise' when key_accounts>=2 or total_organization_ltv>=50000 then 'Key Enterprise' when total_contacts>=5 or total_organization_ltv>=25000 then 'Important Account' when total_contacts>=2 or total_organization_ltv>=10000 then 'Standard Account' else 'Small Account' end as strategic_value_tier,
 case when total_contacts=1 then 'High Concentration Risk' when total_contacts<=3 then 'Medium Concentration Risk' when email_domains_count=1 and total_contacts>=5 then 'Domain Concentration Risk' else 'Low Concentration Risk' end as concentration_risk
 from aggs
), network as (
 select *,round(100*total_organization_ltv/nullif(sum(total_organization_ltv) over(partition by organization_type),0),4) as market_share_within_type,
 row_number() over(partition by organization_type order by total_organization_ltv desc) as ltv_rank_within_type,
 row_number() over(partition by organization_type order by total_contacts desc) as contacts_rank_within_type,
 row_number() over(partition by organization_type order by organization_value_score desc) as value_score_rank_within_type,
 case when total_contacts>=5 and marketing_contacts=0 then 3 when total_contacts>=3 and sales_contacts=0 then 3 when total_contacts>=2 and support_contacts=0 then 2 else 0 end+
 case growth_potential when 'High Growth Potential' then 2 when 'Medium Growth Potential' then 1 else 0 end+
 case when avg_engagement_score>=3.5 then 2 when avg_engagement_score>=3 then 1 else 0 end as cross_sell_opportunity_score
 from scored
), final as (
 select *,case when strategic_value_tier in ('Strategic Enterprise','Key Enterprise') and growth_potential='High Growth Potential' then 'Immediate Expansion' when organization_value_score>=4 and organization_health_score>=4 then 'High Priority Expansion' when total_contacts>=3 and avg_engagement_score>=3 then 'Medium Priority Expansion' when total_contacts>=2 and organization_risk_level='Stable' then 'Low Priority Expansion' else 'Maintenance Mode' end as expansion_priority,

 from network

MAX(estimated_customer_ltv) AS highest_customer_ltv, AVG(composite_engagement_score) AS avg_engagement_score, MAX(composite_engagement_score) AS max_engagement_score, AVG(customer_health_score) AS avg_health_score, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE customer_journey_pattern = 'Full Journey') AS BIGINT) AS full_journey_contacts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE strategic_classification = 'Strategic Account') AS BIGINT) AS strategic_accounts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE strategic_classification = 'Key Account') AS BIGINT) AS key_accounts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE strategic_classification = 'Growth Account') AS BIGINT) AS growth_accounts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE strategic_classification = 'Recovery Account') AS BIGINT) AS recovery_accounts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE customer_segment = 'Champion') AS BIGINT) AS champions, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE customer_segment = 'Loyal Customer') AS BIGINT) AS loyal_customers, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE customer_segment = 'At Risk') AS BIGINT) AS at_risk_customers, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE revenue_tier = 'Tier 1 - Strategic') AS BIGINT) AS tier1_contacts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE revenue_tier = 'Tier 2 - High Value') AS BIGINT) AS tier2_contacts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE revenue_tier = 'Tier 3 - Core') AS BIGINT) AS tier3_contacts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE lifecycle_stage = 'Growth') AS BIGINT) AS growth_stage_contacts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE lifecycle_stage = 'Maturity') AS BIGINT) AS maturity_stage_contacts, CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT primary_email) FILTER(WHERE lifecycle_stage = 'Dormant') AS BIGINT) AS dormant_contacts FROM classified GROUP BY ALL

SELECT *, CAST(ROUND((CASE WHEN total_organization_ltv >= 50000 THEN 5 WHEN total_organization_ltv >= 25000 THEN 4 WHEN total_organization_ltv >= 10000 THEN 3 WHEN total_organization_ltv >= 5000 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 0.4 + CASE WHEN total_contacts >= 10 THEN 5 WHEN total_contacts >= 5 THEN 4 WHEN total_contacts >= 3 THEN 3 WHEN total_contacts >= 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 0.3 + CASE WHEN avg_engagement_score >= 4 THEN 5 WHEN avg_engagement_score >= 3 THEN 4 WHEN avg_engagement_score >= 2.5 THEN 3 WHEN avg_engagement_score >= 2 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END * 0.3), 2) AS DECIMAL(14, 1)) AS maturity_stage_contacts) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_contacts, 0) * 5, 2) AS organization_health_score, ROUND(5.0 * CAST((marketing_contacts + sales_contacts + support_contacts) AS DOUBLE) / (3 * NULLIF(total_contacts, 0)), 2) AS account_penetration_score, ROUND(100 * CAST((0.3 * marketing_contacts + 0.4 * sales_contacts + 0.3 * support_contacts) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(total_contacts, 0), 2) AS engagement_breadth_percentage, CASE WHEN total_contacts >= 10 AND full_journey_contacts >= 3 THEN 'Mature Enterprise' WHEN total_contacts >= 5 AND strategic_accounts + key_accounts >= 2 THEN 'High Risk' WHEN dormant_contacts >= 0.3 * total_contacts THEN 'Medium Risk' WHEN recovery_accounts >= 1 THEN 'Attention Needed' ELSE 'Stable' END AS organization_risk_level, CASE WHEN strategic_accounts >= 2 OR total_organization_ltv >= 100000 THEN 'Strategic Enterprise' WHEN key_accounts >= 2 OR total_organization_ltv >= 50000 THEN 'Key Enterprise' WHEN total_contacts >= 5 OR total_contacts = 1 THEN 'High Concentration Risk' WHEN total_contacts <= 3 THEN 'Medium Concentration Risk' WHEN email_domains_count = 1 AND total_contacts >= 5 THEN 'Domain Concentration Risk' ELSE blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__organization_network
      description: Organization-level network, value, health, engagement, risk, ranking, and strategy metrics grouped by standardized_org_name + email_domain (INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER excluded)
      grain: One row per (standardized_org_name, email_domain, organization_type, estimated_org_size)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_behavior_analysis
      - intermediate.int_customer360__customer_lifecycle_metrics
      - marts.customer360__customer_value_analysis
      business_logic: '- Build organization_entities: - Join behavior_analysis to lifecycle_metrics on primary_email; join behavior_analysis to value_analysis on primary_email. - Retain ids (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id), journey/segment fields, LTV/health/engagement fields. - Standardize fields: - standardized_org_name: uppercase and trim primary_organization; if null/blank set "INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER". - email_domain: take the substring after "@" in primary_email; if missing set "unknown.domain". - organization_type by primary_organization text patterns: - null/blank → Individual - contains inc/corp/llc/ltd → Corporation - contains university/college/school → Education - contains government/dept/agency → Government - contains nonprofit/foundation/charity → Non-Profit - otherwise → Business - estimated_org_size: - domain in {gmail.com,yahoo.com,hotmail.com,outlook.com} → Personal - domain in {microsoft.com,google.com,amazon.com,apple.com,facebook.com} → Enterprise - else if name length > 20 → Large Business; > 10 → Medium Business; > 0 → Small Business; otherwise → Individual - Aggregate to organization_aggregates at (standardized_org_name, email_domain, organization_type, estimated_org_size): - Counts (distinct primary_email): total_contacts; marketing_contacts when marketo_lead_id present; sales_contacts when stripe_customer_id present; support_contacts when zendesk_user_id present. - Journey distribution: full_journey_contacts when journey pattern = "Full Journey"; also compute marketing_to_sales_contacts and sales_to_support_contacts (used downstream). - Value metrics: total_organization_ltv (sum of estimated_customer_ltv), avg_customer_ltv, highest_customer_ltv (max), total_adjusted_ltv (sum). - Engagement/health: avg_engagement_score (average composite_engagement_score), max_engagement_score (max), avg_health_score (average customer_health_score). - Strategic classification: strategic_accounts, key_accounts, growth_accounts, recovery_accounts from strategic_classification. - Revenue tiers: tier1_contacts, tier2_contacts, tier3_contacts from revenue_tier. - Customer segments: champions, loyal_customers, at_risk_customers from customer_segment. - Lifecycle stages (for health calc): growth_stage_contacts when stage = "Growth"; maturity_stage_contacts when stage = "Maturity"; dormant_contacts when stage = "Dormant". - Diversity: email_domains_count = distinct email_domain within the group (will be 1); customer_tiers_represented = distinct customer_tier. - Compute organization_scoring: - organization_value_score: weighted sum of three 1–5 tiers, rounded to two decimals (stored with one-decimal precision): - LTV tier: ≥50000→5; ≥25000→4; ≥10000→3; ≥5000→2; else→1 (weight 0.4). - Contacts tier: ≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥3→3; ≥2→2; else→1 (weight 0.3). - Avg engagement tier: ≥4.0→5; ≥3.0→4; ≥2.5→3; ≥2.0→2; else→1 (weight 0.3). - organization_health_score: 0.4×avg_health_score + 0.3×(champions+loyal_customers)/total_contacts×5 + 0.3×(growth_stage_contacts+maturity_stage_contacts)/total_contacts×5; if total_contacts=0, both ratios are 0; round to two decimals. - account_penetration_score: share of contacts linked across marketing, sales, and support out of three touchpoints, scaled to a 0–5 score and rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0. - organization_maturity: - if total_contacts≥10 and full_journey_contacts≥3 → Mature Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥5 and (strategic_accounts+key_accounts)≥2 → Developing Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥3 and total_organization_ltv≥10000 → Mid-Market - else if total_contacts≥2 → Small Business - else → Individual/Micro - growth_potential: - if growth_accounts≥2 and avg_engagement_score≥3.0 → High Growth Potential - else if growth_accounts≥1 or avg_engagement_score≥3.5 → Medium Growth Potential - else if total_contacts≥2 and avg_health_score≥3.0 → Stable Growth Potential - else → Limited Growth Potential - organization_risk_level: - if at_risk_customers ≥ 50% of total_contacts → High Risk - else if dormant_contacts ≥ 30% of total_contacts → Medium Risk - else if recovery_accounts ≥ 1 → Attention Needed - else → Stable - strategic_value_tier: - if strategic_accounts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥100000 → Strategic Enterprise - else if key_accounts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥50000 → Key Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥5 or total_organization_ltv≥25000 → Important Account - else if total_contacts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥10000 → Standard Account - else → Small Account - engagement_breadth_percentage: weighted coverage across marketing (30%), sales (40%), and support (30%) among contacts, expressed as a percentage and rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0. - concentration_risk: - if total_contacts=1 → High Concentration Risk - else if total_contacts≤3 → Medium Concentration Risk - else if email_domains_count=1 and total_contacts≥5 → Domain Concentration Risk - else → Low Concentration Risk - Perform network_analysis: - market_share_within_type: percent share of total_organization_ltv within the same organization_type, rounded to four decimals; null when the type total is zero. - Rankings within organization_type: ltv_rank_within_type by total_organization_ltv descending; contacts_rank_within_type by total_contacts descending; value_score_rank_within_type by organization_value_score descending; ties break arbitrarily. - cross_sell_opportunity_score (integer 0–7): sum of three components, then rounded (remains integer): - Channel gap: if total_contacts≥5 and marketing_contacts=0 →3; else if total_contacts≥3 and sales_contacts=0 →3; else if total_contacts≥2 and support_contacts=0 →2; else →0. - Growth: High Growth Potential →2; Medium Growth Potential →1; else →0. - Engagement: avg_engagement_score≥3.5 →2; ≥3.0 →1; else →0. - expansion_priority: - if strategic_value_tier in {Strategic Enterprise, Key Enterprise} and growth_potential=High Growth Potential → Immediate Expansion - else if organization_value_score≥4.0 and organization_health_score≥4.0 → High Priority Expansion - else if total_contacts≥3 and avg_engagement_score≥3.0 → Medium Priority Expansion - else if total_contacts≥2 and organization_risk_level=Stable → Low Priority Expansion - else → Maintenance Mode - recommended_strategy: - if organization_risk_level=High Risk → Risk Mitigation & Recovery - else if strategic_value_tier=Strategic Enterprise → White Glove Account Management - else if strategic_value_tier=Key Enterprise → Dedicated Account Management - else if growth_potential=High Growth Potential → Growth & Expansion Focus - else if total_contacts=1 → Relationship Expansion - else → Standard Account Management - Finalization: - organization_influence_score: weighted score rounded to two decimals = 0.3×organization_value_score + 0.3×contacts tier (≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥3→3; ≥2→2; else→1) + 0.2×breadth tier (≥80→5; ≥60→4; ≥40→3; ≥20→2; else→1) + 0.2×market-share tier (≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥2→3; ≥1→2; else→1). - risk_adjusted_organization_value: total_adjusted_ltv multiplied by expansion priority multiplier (Immediate 1.5; High 1.3; Medium 1.1; else 1.0), then reduced by risk penalty (High Risk 40%; Medium Risk 20%; Attention Needed 10%; else 0%), rounded to two decimals. - network_analysis_timestamp: set to the current timestamp at computation time. - Exclude rows where standardized_org_name = "INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER". - Order output by organization_influence_score (desc), then total_organization_ltv (desc), then total_contacts (desc).'
      columns:
      - name: standardized_org_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Uppercased, trimmed organization name from behavior_analysis; null/blank becomes 'INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER' and is excluded from final output
      - name: email_domain
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Substring after '@' in primary_email; if missing set to 'unknown.domain'
      - name: organization_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Derived from primary_organization patterns: Individual, Corporation, Education, Government, Non-Profit, or Business'
      - name: estimated_org_size
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Size class from email_domain and name length: Personal, Enterprise, Large/Medium/Small Business, or Individual'
      - name: organization_maturity
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Mature Enterprise if contacts≥10 and full_journey≥3; Developing Enterprise if contacts≥5 and strategic+key≥2; Mid-Market if contacts≥3 and org LTV≥10000; Small Business if contacts≥2; else Individual/Micro
      - name: strategic_value_tier
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Strategic Enterprise if strategic≥2 or org LTV≥100000; Key Enterprise if key≥2 or org LTV≥50000; Important if contacts≥5 or org LTV≥25000; Standard if contacts≥2 or org LTV≥10000; else Small
      - name: total_contacts
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of primary_email within the group

specification.name: customer360__organization_network
specification.description: Organization-level network, value, health, engagement, risk, ranking, and strategy metrics grouped by standardized_org_name + email_domain (INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER excluded)
specification.grain: One row per (standardized_org_name, email_domain, organization_type, estimated_org_size)
specification.business_logic: - Build organization_entities: - Join behavior_analysis to lifecycle_metrics on primary_email; join behavior_analysis to value_analysis on primary_email. - Retain ids (marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id), journey/segment fields, LTV/health/engagement fields. - Standardize fields: - standardized_org_name: uppercase and trim primary_organization; if null/blank set "INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER". - email_domain: take the substring after "@" in primary_email; if missing set "unknown.domain". - organization_type by primary_organization text patterns: - null/blank → Individual - contains inc/corp/llc/ltd → Corporation - contains university/college/school → Education - contains government/dept/agency → Government - contains nonprofit/foundation/charity → Non-Profit - otherwise → Business - estimated_org_size: - domain in {gmail.com,yahoo.com,hotmail.com,outlook.com} → Personal - domain in {microsoft.com,google.com,amazon.com,apple.com,facebook.com} → Enterprise - else if name length > 20 → Large Business; > 10 → Medium Business; > 0 → Small Business; otherwise → Individual - Aggregate to organization_aggregates at (standardized_org_name, email_domain, organization_type, estimated_org_size): - Counts (distinct primary_email): total_contacts; marketing_contacts when marketo_lead_id present; sales_contacts when stripe_customer_id present; support_contacts when zendesk_user_id present. - Journey distribution: full_journey_contacts when journey pattern = "Full Journey"; also compute marketing_to_sales_contacts and sales_to_support_contacts (used downstream). - Value metrics: total_organization_ltv (sum of estimated_customer_ltv), avg_customer_ltv, highest_customer_ltv (max), total_adjusted_ltv (sum). - Engagement/health: avg_engagement_score (average composite_engagement_score), max_engagement_score (max), avg_health_score (average customer_health_score). - Strategic classification: strategic_accounts, key_accounts, growth_accounts, recovery_accounts from strategic_classification. - Revenue tiers: tier1_contacts, tier2_contacts, tier3_contacts from revenue_tier. - Customer segments: champions, loyal_customers, at_risk_customers from customer_segment. - Lifecycle stages (for health calc): growth_stage_contacts when stage = "Growth"; maturity_stage_contacts when stage = "Maturity"; dormant_contacts when stage = "Dormant". - Diversity: email_domains_count = distinct email_domain within the group (will be 1); customer_tiers_represented = distinct customer_tier. - Compute organization_scoring: - organization_value_score: weighted sum of three 1–5 tiers, rounded to two decimals (stored with one-decimal precision): - LTV tier: ≥50000→5; ≥25000→4; ≥10000→3; ≥5000→2; else→1 (weight 0.4). - Contacts tier: ≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥3→3; ≥2→2; else→1 (weight 0.3). - Avg engagement tier: ≥4.0→5; ≥3.0→4; ≥2.5→3; ≥2.0→2; else→1 (weight 0.3). - organization_health_score: 0.4×avg_health_score + 0.3×(champions+loyal_customers)/total_contacts×5 + 0.3×(growth_stage_contacts+maturity_stage_contacts)/total_contacts×5; if total_contacts=0, both ratios are 0; round to two decimals. - account_penetration_score: share of contacts linked across marketing, sales, and support out of three touchpoints, scaled to a 0–5 score and rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0. - organization_maturity: - if total_contacts≥10 and full_journey_contacts≥3 → Mature Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥5 and (strategic_accounts+key_accounts)≥2 → Developing Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥3 and total_organization_ltv≥10000 → Mid-Market - else if total_contacts≥2 → Small Business - else → Individual/Micro - growth_potential: - if growth_accounts≥2 and avg_engagement_score≥3.0 → High Growth Potential - else if growth_accounts≥1 or avg_engagement_score≥3.5 → Medium Growth Potential - else if total_contacts≥2 and avg_health_score≥3.0 → Stable Growth Potential - else → Limited Growth Potential - organization_risk_level: - if at_risk_customers ≥ 50% of total_contacts → High Risk - else if dormant_contacts ≥ 30% of total_contacts → Medium Risk - else if recovery_accounts ≥ 1 → Attention Needed - else → Stable - strategic_value_tier: - if strategic_accounts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥100000 → Strategic Enterprise - else if key_accounts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥50000 → Key Enterprise - else if total_contacts≥5 or total_organization_ltv≥25000 → Important Account - else if total_contacts≥2 or total_organization_ltv≥10000 → Standard Account - else → Small Account - engagement_breadth_percentage: weighted coverage across marketing (30%), sales (40%), and support (30%) among contacts, expressed as a percentage and rounded to two decimals; 0 when total_contacts=0. - concentration_risk: - if total_contacts=1 → High Concentration Risk - else if total_contacts≤3 → Medium Concentration Risk - else if email_domains_count=1 and total_contacts≥5 → Domain Concentration Risk - else → Low Concentration Risk - Perform network_analysis: - market_share_within_type: percent share of total_organization_ltv within the same organization_type, rounded to four decimals; null when the type total is zero. - Rankings within organization_type: ltv_rank_within_type by total_organization_ltv descending; contacts_rank_within_type by total_contacts descending; value_score_rank_within_type by organization_value_score descending; ties break arbitrarily. - cross_sell_opportunity_score (integer 0–7): sum of three components, then rounded (remains integer): - Channel gap: if total_contacts≥5 and marketing_contacts=0 →3; else if total_contacts≥3 and sales_contacts=0 →3; else if total_contacts≥2 and support_contacts=0 →2; else →0. - Growth: High Growth Potential →2; Medium Growth Potential →1; else →0. - Engagement: avg_engagement_score≥3.5 →2; ≥3.0 →1; else →0. - expansion_priority: - if strategic_value_tier in {Strategic Enterprise, Key Enterprise} and growth_potential=High Growth Potential → Immediate Expansion - else if organization_value_score≥4.0 and organization_health_score≥4.0 → High Priority Expansion - else if total_contacts≥3 and avg_engagement_score≥3.0 → Medium Priority Expansion - else if total_contacts≥2 and organization_risk_level=Stable → Low Priority Expansion - else → Maintenance Mode - recommended_strategy: - if organization_risk_level=High Risk → Risk Mitigation & Recovery - else if strategic_value_tier=Strategic Enterprise → White Glove Account Management - else if strategic_value_tier=Key Enterprise → Dedicated Account Management - else if growth_potential=High Growth Potential → Growth & Expansion Focus - else if total_contacts=1 → Relationship Expansion - else → Standard Account Management - Finalization: - organization_influence_score: weighted score rounded to two decimals = 0.3×organization_value_score + 0.3×contacts tier (≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥3→3; ≥2→2; else→1) + 0.2×breadth tier (≥80→5; ≥60→4; ≥40→3; ≥20→2; else→1) + 0.2×market-share tier (≥10→5; ≥5→4; ≥2→3; ≥1→2; else→1). - risk_adjusted_organization_value: total_adjusted_ltv multiplied by expansion priority multiplier (Immediate 1.5; High 1.3; Medium 1.1; else 1.0), then reduced by risk penalty (High Risk 40%; Medium Risk 20%; Attention Needed 10%; else 0%), rounded to two decimals. - network_analysis_timestamp: set to the current timestamp at computation time. - Exclude rows where standardized_org_name = "INDIVIDUAL_CUSTOMER". - Order output by organization_influence_score (desc), then total_organization_ltv (desc), then total_contacts (desc).

with phone_rows as (
 select m.customer360_id,s.phone,s.phone_extension::varchar as extension from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo s on m.marketo_lead_id=s.lead_id where s.phone is not null
 union all select m.customer360_id,s.company_phone,s.company_phone_extension::varchar from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo s on m.marketo_lead_id=s.lead_id where s.company_phone is not null
 union all select m.customer360_id,s.mobile_phone,s.mobile_phone_extension from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo s on m.marketo_lead_id=s.lead_id where s.mobile_phone is not null
 union all select m.customer360_id,s.phone,s.phone_extension::varchar from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on m.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id where s.phone is not null
 union all select m.customer360_id,s.shipping_phone,s.shipping_phone_extension::varchar from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on m.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id where s.shipping_phone is not null
 union all select m.customer360_id,s.phone,s.phone_extension::varchar from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk s on m.zendesk_user_id=s.user_id where s.phone is not null
), unique_phones as (select distinct customer360_id,phone,extension from phone_rows)
select customer360_id,phone,extension,row_number() over(partition by customer360_id order by phone) as index from unique_phones

agent_sql.raw_text:
with status_rows as (
 select m.customer360_id,k.is_unsubscribed,k.is_email_invalid,k.do_not_call,
 case when k.is_unsubscribed then 'unsubscribed' when k.is_email_invalid then 'email_invalid' when k.do_not_call then 'do_not_call' else 'active' end as status,'marketo' as source_system
 from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__marketo k on m.marketo_lead_id=k.lead_id
 union all select m.customer360_id,false,false,false,case when s.is_delinquent then 'delinquent' when s.is_deleted then 'deleted' else 'active' end,'stripe'
 from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__stripe s on m.stripe_customer_id=s.customer_id
 union all select m.customer360_id,false,false,false,case when z.is_suspended then 'suspended' when z.is_deleted then 'deleted' when z.is_active=false then 'inactive' else 'active' end,'zendesk'
 from marts.customer360__mapping m join intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk z on m.zendesk_user_id=z.user_id
), aggregated as (
 select customer360_id,bool_or(is_unsubscribed) as is_unsubscribed,bool_or(is_email_invalid) as is_email_invalid,bool_or(do_not_call) as do_not_call,
 bool_or(status='active') as any_active,bool_or(status='suspended') as any_suspended,bool_or(status='delinquent') as any_delinquent,
 string_agg(distinct source_system,', ') as source_systems from status_rows group by customer360_id
)
select customer360_id,is_unsubscribed,is_email_invalid,do_not_call,
 case when is_unsubscribed then 'unsubscribed' when is_email_invalid then 'email_invalid' when any_active then 'active' when any_suspended then 'suspended' when any_delinquent then 'delinquent' else 'inactive' end as overall_status,source_systems
from aggregated

Stripe and Zendesk always contribute FALSE. - overall_status precedence: 1) unsubscribed if the aggregated unsubscribe flag is TRUE; 2) email_invalid if the aggregated email_invalid flag is TRUE; 3) active if any per-row status is active; 4) suspended if any per-row status is suspended; 5) delinquent if any per-row status is delinquent; 6) otherwise inactive. blocks.original_text:
- name: customer360__updates
      description: Per-customer summary of updates from Marketo, Stripe, and Zendesk, showing latest and earliest timestamps, total updates, and distinct source/type lists.
      grain: One row per customer360_id that has at least one joined update from any source
      source_models:
      - marts.customer360__mapping
      - intermediate.int_customer360__marketo
      - intermediate.int_customer360__stripe
      - intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk
      business_logic: '- Read customer-to-source IDs from marts.customer360__mapping (customer360_id, marketo_lead_id, stripe_customer_id, zendesk_user_id). - Create update rows via inner joins: - Marketo: join mapping.marketo_lead_id to intermediate.int_customer360__marketo.lead_id; take updated_at as last_updated and created_at as first_seen; set source_system=''marketo'' and update_type=''lead_update''. - Stripe: join mapping.stripe_customer_id to intermediate.int_customer360__stripe.customer_id; take updated_at as last_updated and created_at as first_seen; set source_system=''stripe'' and update_type=''customer_update''. - Zendesk: join mapping.zendesk_user_id to intermediate.int_customer360__zendesk.user_id; take updated_at as last_updated and created_at as first_seen; set source_system=''zendesk'' and update_type=''user_update''. - Union all per-source rows; duplicates are preserved. - Aggregate by customer360_id: - last_updated: the latest non-null last_updated across all rows; returns null if all are null. - first_seen: the earliest non-null first_seen across all rows; returns null if all are null. - total_updates: the count of all joined rows across sources; includes duplicates and rows with null timestamps. - updated_by_systems: concatenate distinct source_system values with ", "; case preserved; nulls excluded; no guaranteed ordering. - update_types: concatenate distinct update_type values with ", "; case preserved; nulls excluded; no guaranteed ordering. - Output includes only customers with at least one joined update row.'
      columns:
      - name: customer360_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique customer identifier; one row per value.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: last_updated
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Latest non-null update timestamp across sources; null if none.
      - name: first_seen
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Earliest non-null creation timestamp across sources; null if none.
      - name: total_updates
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of joined update rows across sources; includes duplicates and rows with null timestamps.
      - name: updated_by_systems
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Distinct source systems concatenated with ', '; order not guaranteed; case preserved; nulls excluded.
      - name: update_types
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Distinct update types concatenated with ', '; order not guaranteed; case preserved; nulls excluded.
